## v2.137p142 — Feat: tenant-agnostic demo reporting seeder (report def + widget + dashboard per tenant + global query catalog, P7b) (2026-06-02)

**Type:** feat (reporting seeding + test) | **Scope:** new DemoReportingSeeder + DI wiring + appsettings + reset-all + SeederMarker anchor + test | **Status:** SHIPPED (local main). **P7 COMPLETE** — Integration (7c) + Rules (7a) + Reporting (7b) all done → closes the niche-defs slice of the 7-phase reseed plan.

**P7b — Demo reporting definitions:** NEW `DemoReportingSeeder` (Reporting.Infrastructure/Seeding) seeds, per `TenantSeedProfiles` entry (BoTaiChinh + BoNoiVu), ONE `ReportDefinition` + ONE `ReportWidget` + ONE `DashboardLayout` whose grid references the seeded widget, plus a single GLOBAL `QueryCatalogEntry` (the NLQ catalog is system-wide, seeded once outside the tenant loop). Definitions only — no `ReportExecution` runtime rows. Module-resident + self-contained (no cross-module FK), mirrors the P7c Integration / P7a Rules / P4 / P5 seeders. Gated `Reporting:DemoReportingSeed` (default OFF; ON in Development + reset-all). Completion marker (polled by reset-all.ps1): `[DemoReportingSeeder] All tenants complete`.

**Three tenant-scope shapes honoured (the module's defining quirk):** `ReportDefinition.TenantId` is a `string?` slug (NOT ITenantScoped) — the query handler compares it against `tenantContext.TenantId?.ToString()`, so the seeder writes `profile.TenantId.ToString()` to make the row visible to a tenant user; idempotent on the DB unique `(Name, TenantId)`. `ReportWidget` + `DashboardLayout` are Guid `ITenantScoped` (EF global filter applies, bypassed via `SystemSeederTenantContext`). `QueryCatalogEntry` has no tenant key at all — global, idempotent on its unique `Code`.

**Naming asymmetry is load-bearing:** the widget unique key is `(Name, TenantId)` so a shared name across tenants is correct and keeps cross-tenant rows distinct; the dashboard unique key is `(Name, OwnerId)` and every demo dashboard is owned by the system actor (`Guid.Empty`), so the dashboard name MUST be tenant-distinct (`…(demo) — {profile.Name}`) or two tenants collide on `(Name, Guid.Empty)`.

**Two-phase save, transaction-wrapped:** Phase 1 inserts the report definition + widget in one SaveChanges; the widget's IDENTITY Id is only known afterwards. Phase 2 builds the dashboard grid JSON (`[{"widgetId":"{id}",…}]`) referencing that assigned widget.Id — the widgets are linked by id-in-JSON, not an FK navigation — then inserts the dashboard. Both phases wrapped in `BeginTransactionAsync`/`CommitAsync` so a phase-2 fault rolls the report back rather than leaving a committed report whose anchor probe would skip the tenant forever on a plain restart (P6/P7c lesson applied proactively → review 0 Crit/High). The per-tenant block uses a single anchor probe (the report definition); transaction atomicity makes that sufficient. The global catalog entry has its own `Code` probe.

**Self-contained literal SQL:** the report template, widget query, and catalog query are each a fully-parameterized literal `SELECT CAST(0 AS bigint) … WHERE @TenantId IS NOT NULL` — carries `@TenantId` (which all three executors bind server-side, so the demo data renders, not just inserts), touches no table, and depends on no schema (the Cases module that the old reports targeted was deleted in PR #71). No injection surface (all literals); `CrossSchemaSqlScanner` cannot trip (no FROM/JOIN).

**Drift-guard:** added the `Reporting.Infrastructure` assembly anchor to `SeederMarkerContractTests`. The PR#71 `ReportDefinitionSeeder` is a comment-only tombstone (no class, never DI-registered) — `DemoReportingSeeder` is the sole live `*Seeder` in the module and implements both `IHostedService` + `IIntegrationTestSeeder`.

**No migration / no entity change.** All four entities + EF configs pre-existed. DI: gated `AddHostedService` in `AddReportingInfrastructure` (module, not host).

**Tests:** NEW `DemoReportingSeederTests` (3 facts, real SQL): T1 per-tenant report def (active, slug, NameVi diacritic) + widget (KPI) + dashboard (grid JSON contains the assigned widget.Id — proves the two-phase linkage) + exactly one global catalog entry, T2 idempotency (second run no dup of any of the four entities), T3 cross-tenant isolation (report def same Name distinct slug → 2 rows; widget shared name distinct TenantId → 2 distinct rows). Build slnx 0E/0W. SeederMarkerContractTests 2/2 (now scanning Reporting.Infrastructure). Startup smoke 1/1 (real StartAsync boot, /health/live 200 = no seeder throws). Full Reporting.Integration.Tests 7/7 (no regression to DashboardEndpointsTests). Code-review APPROVE 0 Crit/High.

**Known / accepted (family-wide, named honestly):** transaction-rollback path + StartAsync boot path are not fault-injection-tested (same as the sibling demo seeders). None are regressions.

**Closes:** Phase 7 niche defs (Rules + Reporting + Integration all shipped). Manual reset-all smoke folded into `WF-DEMO-SEED-SMOKE` (now covering P4+P5+P6+P7c+P7a+P7b). `P3b` FE 2-level geo migration remains a separate gated follow-up.

## v2.137p139 — Feat: host-resident demo BusinessProcess seeder (Draft BP wiring workflow + intake form, P6) (2026-06-02)

**Type:** feat (host seeding + test) | **Scope:** new DemoBusinessProcessSeeder (host) + gated DI + appsettings + reset-all + test | **Status:** SHIPPED (local main).

**P6 — Demo BusinessProcess definitions:** NEW `DemoBusinessProcessSeeder` (`src/host/AqtCoreFW.Api`) seeds ONE Draft `BusinessProcessDefinition` per `TenantSeedProfiles` entry (BoTaiChinh + BoNoiVu), pairing the demo Workflow definition (`DemoWorkflowSeeder`, DefinitionKey `demo-generic-process`) with the demo intake Form template (`DemoFormTemplateSeeder`, Code `demo-intake-form`). Wiring: BP `IntakeFormTemplateId` + version pin (GOV_BP_010 both-or-neither) + 1 `BusinessProcessStateForm` bound to the Draft (initial) state + 1 `BusinessProcessTransitionForm` bound to the Submit transition — a minimal, semantically-honest demo. Left in **Draft** (IsActive=false): operator activates in the UI, which re-runs the R1-R4 graph validator. No BP runs (WorkflowInstances) seeded. Gated `BusinessProcess:DemoBusinessProcessSeed` (default OFF; ON in Development + reset-all). Idempotent per `(TenantId, Code="demo-business-process")` — unique index load-bearing. Completion marker (polled by reset-all.ps1): `[DemoBusinessProcessSeeder] All tenants complete`.

**Host-resident — the first cross-module seeder (user-approved architecture):** unlike the per-module P4/P5 demo seeders, BP must read across module boundaries (Workflow def + states + transitions, Form template + version). `ModuleIsolationTests.NoModule_Should_DirectlyReference_AnotherModule` forbids module→module references, and the cross-module client contracts (`IWorkflowModuleClient` / `IFormTemplateQueryClient`) expose only PublicId-keyed resolution — not the natural-key (DefinitionKey / Code) lookups a seeder holds. The composition root already references all module Infrastructure and is the sanctioned place for cross-module seeding (mirrors `E2ETestDataSeeder`). This avoids widening the production cross-module contract for a dev-only seeder. Reads/writes from a single startup scope use `new XDbContext(dbOptions, SystemSeederTenantContext.Instance)` + `IgnoreQueryFilters()` — cross-tenant only on a db_owner connection (RLS bypass), same as P4/P5.

**Fail-loud + transaction-wrapped:** dependency resolution throws (not silent-skip) on any null/≤0 resolve — missing workflow def, Draft state, Submit transition, form template, or published version — since a missing dependency is a startup-ordering regression, and a silent skip would ship a half-wired BP. Registration order (Forms + Workflow module seeders before the host BP seeder) + the generic host's sequential `StartAsync` guarantee the dependencies are committed first; the throw is the backstop. The 2-phase save (BP root → form-map children, split because children carry the DB-assigned bp.Id) is wrapped in a single transaction so a phase-2 fault cannot leave a committed root with zero bindings that the root-keyed probe would skip forever on a plain restart.

**No migration / no entity change.** All BP entities + config pre-existed (BP MVP). DI: gated `AddHostedService` in `Program.cs` after the BusinessProcess module registration.

**Tests:** NEW `DemoBusinessProcessSeederTests` (5 facts, real SQL): T1 one Draft BP/tenant linked to workflow def + intake form + version + Vietnamese round-trip, T2 form maps bind the intake form to the Draft state + Submit transition with valid FKs, T3 idempotency (second run no-op, no dup BP/maps), T4 missing-workflow fail-loud (throws + no BP row persisted), T5 missing-form fail-loud. Build slnx 0E. SeederMarkerContractTests 2/2 (host seeder marker honored). ModuleIsolationTests 12/12. Code-review APPROVE-WITH-NITS 0 Crit/High (M1 partial-failure → fixed via transaction wrap; follow-up `SEED-TXN-WRAP-P4-P5` to propagate to P4/P5).

**Out of scope:** BP runs (none seeded); UI activation + routing smoke (folded into `WF-DEMO-SEED-SMOKE`). Known gap `BP-FORM-OPTIONS-SNAPSHOT` bites here — the intake EnumRef dropdown renders empty at BP-run until the form snapshot carries options.

## v2.137p130 — Fix: transition authz honors role/group/org-unit (pool task was un-actionable) + claim button (2026-05-30)

**Type:** fix (workflow engine authz) + feat (FE claim) | **Scope:** 2 handlers + ResolverAuthz + new loader + 6 tests + 2 FE | **Status:** SHIPPED (`c443e9e0`, local main, **unpushed**).

**Symptom:** A pool task (e.g. ByRole `GovOfficer`) was inbox-visible and claimable but its outgoing transition ("Duyệt" / Approve) was hidden in "Thao tác" and 403 on execute — the run got stuck with no actionable step. User read it as "missing claim button"; root cause was authz, not claim.

**Root cause (source-verified):** `ResolverAuthz.IsActorAuthorized` matched candidate predicate `.Ref` only against the actor's effective **permission codes**, ignoring `PrincipalType`. A `Role`/`Group`/`OrgUnit` predicate (ref = role name / group code / org-unit code) never matched permission codes → deny. The read/claim side (`GetInboxQueryHandler` / `IsPoolEligibleAsync`) was extended to 4 principal types across RT2-15, but the transition-authz side was left permission-only — an **untracked** asymmetry (not a deferred phase; backlog/plans audit found no row).

**Fix:** `ResolverAuthz` now matches each predicate by its type against the actor's `{permissionCodes, roleNames, groupCodes, orgUnitCodes}` (new `ActorPrincipals` + `ActorPrincipalsLoader`, loading the SAME four sets the inbox/claim path uses — role names direct-only). Updated all 3 call sites: `GetAvailableTransitionsQueryHandler` + `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler` (actor + override-target paths); both now inject `IOrgUnitModuleClient`. No new cross-module method. **Invariant restored: inbox-visible + claimable ⟹ actionable.**

**FE:** "Nhận việc" claim button on the next-handler card (`useClaimTask` → `POST /workflow/tasks/{id}/claim`) for eligible users; claim is optional ownership (not required to act after this fix).

**Tests:** NEW `ResolverAuthzTests` (type-aware matrix incl. role-name-in-permission-set → denied) + a ByRole handler-visibility test; existing ByPermission tests unchanged (regression). `Workflow.Application.Tests` 600/600, build 0E, FE typecheck clean. Verified live: GovOfficer-by-role user sees + executes "Duyệt"; claim flow end-to-end (DB AssigneeId set, UI → "Đã giao").

## v2.137p127 — Fix: transition orphans source-state task (inbox duplicate) (2026-05-29)

**Type:** fix (workflow engine) | **Scope:** 1 handler + 1 repo method + 1 integration test + 1 data cleanup | **Status:** SHIPPED (local main, **unpushed**).

**Symptom:** "Chờ xử lý" inbox showed one BP run twice (same `workflowInstanceId`). Diagnosed empirically: instance had 2 Open `WorkflowTask` rows (distinct long Ids, same instance) — a stale Draft task + the live InReview task. Inbox lists per-task, so the same dossier surfaced on two rows (one user was both Draft-assignee and InReview-pool-member).

**Root cause:** `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler` stages the next-state task on a transition but never completes the source-state task. Task completion lived only in the separate `CompleteTaskCommandHandler`, which the BP "Submit"/transition path never invokes — so every state a run left orphaned an Open task.

**Fix (Approach A — coupled):** On non-recall transitions, complete the instance's open non-branch task(s) with `Complete(actorId)` before staging the next task, inside the existing single-SaveChanges envelope (S7). `Complete` (not `Cancel`) so `CompletedAt` keeps feeding `GetLastCompletedTaskAsync` (PreviousHandler resolver producer). Covers forward + final targets; branch-child tasks excluded (own lifecycle). New `IWorkflowTaskRepository.GetOpenNonBranchByInstanceAsync` (SQL-filtered, tracked) avoids loading task history into the change-tracker per transition.

**Tests:** NEW `ExecuteBpTransitionTransactionTests.ExecuteBusinessProcessTransition_CompletesSourceStateTask_LeavesSingleOpenTask` — proven to FAIL without the fix (2 Open/0 Done) and PASS with it (1 Open/1 Done). Full Workflow + BusinessProcess integration suite: 94/94. Code review 9/10 (DONE_WITH_CONCERNS).

**Data cleanup:** completed the existing orphan (1 task) so the affected run's inbox shows a single row.

**Known gap (filed `WF-RECALL-ORPHAN-TASK`):** recall transitions still leave their source task Open — pre-existing, same bug class, recall direction; deferred pending recall task-semantics design (Complete vs Cancel + creator re-open).

## v2.137p125 — Fix: BP-Run form rendering + submission (intake/state/transition) (2026-05-29)

**Type:** fix (3 user-facing BP-Run form bugs, found in one live debug session) | **Scope:** 5 BE + 6 FE files | **Status:** SHIPPED (3 commits, local main, **unpushed**): `480ef98b` (500→422) / `dfc16ba4` (intake render) / `261e66f5` (transition contract).

Three distinct defects on the BP-Run "start / transition" flow, fixed and committed separately:

- **500→422 on form-submission failure (`480ef98b`):** `IFormSubmissionRunClient.CreateForBpRunAsync` threw `InvalidOperationException` on validation failure, surfacing as opaque 500 `GOV_SYS_000`. Replaced with a transport-neutral `BpRunSubmissionOutcome` record (no FluentResults — preserves the cross-module gRPC-ready contract). Cross-tenant → NotFound (404); per-field validation → ValidationError (422) carrying the field key. All 3 BP-Run handlers (start / submit-state-form / execute-transition) roll back the cross-module UoW on a failed outcome and translate via `ToFailureResult`.
- **Empty intake/state form render (`dfc16ba4`):** the intake + state-form panels cast the published version-snapshot envelope (`key`/`validation`/`visibility`, no `isActive`) straight to `FormFieldDto`, so the `isActive` filter dropped every field → empty form. NEW `web/src/features/forms/form-snapshot-adapter.ts::parseSnapshotSchema` maps snapshot → renderer-ready `FormFieldDto[]` (`key→fieldKey`, `validation→validationRulesJson`, `isActive:true`); both panels route through it. Verified live: 4-field intake renders + run starts.
- **Transition confirm modal crash (`261e66f5`):** the transition gate returned only internal `long[]` ids while the FE consumed each as an object with `.formTemplatePublicId`/`.fields` → spread-of-undefined crash when a transition required a form (latent; only reachable via a designer-configured required transition form). Enriched the `RequireForms` outcome with `BpRequiredTransitionForm{ transitionFormTemplateId, formTemplatePublicId, schemaJson }` (snapshot inline, mirrors intake/state-form contract); FE decodes `schemaJson` via `parseSnapshotSchema` at the response boundary, feeding the unchanged modal.

- **Verified:** BP.Application.Tests 96/96 (full assembly); BP.Presentation builds 0W/0E; FE typecheck app+test clean; form-snapshot-adapter 3/3. New regression guards: transition handler asserts inline-snapshot shape + snapshot-missing→404. Code review 0 blocking (root cause addressed, JSON casing camelCase verified, parseSnapshotSchema fail-safe on malformed). Bug 1 + Bug 2 verified live (422 curl + form render + submit); Bug 3 latent — structural + unit proof only (no required transition form seeded).
- **Contract note:** transition response wire shape changed (`long[]` → object[]); `docs/dependency-map.md` updated. Each commit is bisect-clean (Bug-1/Bug-3 share the transition handler + test; split by revert-then-reapply of the Bug-3 hunk).

## Fix — BP-Run cross-module distributed-transaction eliminated (ambient unit-of-work) (2026-05-28)

**Type:** fix (P1 cross-platform / data-integrity) + 1 pre-existing bug fix | **Scope:** new SharedKernel infra + 2 BP handlers + 4 repositories + base repository + 4 integration tests + docs | **Status:** SHIPPED (local `main`, 5 commits, unpushed at write time).

BP-Run start (and form-gated transitions) wrapped cross-module writes — Workflow + Forms DbContexts, plus eager Identity reads in the transition — in a `System.Transactions.TransactionScope`. On .NET 10 a second physical `SqlConnection` inside that scope promotes to a distributed transaction; `TransactionManager.ImplicitDistributedTransactions` defaults **false on all platforms**, so it threw `NotSupportedException` (HTTP 500) — the "Khởi tạo quy trình thất bại" error, reproducible locally, not only on Linux/Docker (no MSDTC).

- **`0a675d3c` — ambient `ICrossModuleUnitOfWork` infra.** One shared `SqlConnection` + one local SQL transaction; module DbContexts and Dapper reads enlist onto it (`SetDbConnection`+`UseTransaction`, idempotent, first-touch). `sp_set_session_context(TenantId)` set once on Begin (RLS). Implements both `IDisposable` + `IAsyncDisposable`. `DapperReadDbConnection` ambient-aware; `GenericRepository` base auto-enlists on write/GetById when a UoW is active (dormant otherwise). MARS now a load-bearing precondition, guarded by `MarsConnectionStringGuardTests`.
- **`89ddf7b4` — 2 BP handlers** swapped `TransactionScope` for `BeginAsync`/`CommitAsync` with explicit `RollbackAsync` on every failure path; reads moved outside the transaction. The existing cooperative-rollback contract (`HasAmbientTransaction`) is preserved — enlisting sets `Database.CurrentTransaction`. External behaviour unchanged.
- **`29498a73` — pre-existing bug fix:** `WorkflowInstanceRepository.GetByIdAsync(Guid)` queried the long primary key via base `FindAsync`, so a Guid (PublicId) lookup threw `ArgumentException`, masked as a generic 400. Three call paths (`GetTenantForInstanceAsync`, `ResolveTransitionIdAsync`, `CreateWorkflowTaskCommandHandler`) were silently broken; never caught because unit tests mock the repo and no integration test hit a real DB. Now queries by PublicId.
- **`39196af4` — 4 real-SQL integration tests** with `ImplicitDistributedTransactions` left default: BP-Run+intake → 200 + both rows; forced mid-transaction form failure → atomic rollback (zero orphans); transition → 200; read-then-write → no promotion.
- **Tests:** Workflow.Integration 74/74 · Identity.Integration 212/212 · Forms.Integration 9/9 · Workflow.App 587/587 · BP.App 95/95 · Architecture 108/108 · build 0E. Review APPROVE-WITH-NITS; reviewer's High (base write methods lacked an enlist guard — future write-first foot-gun) fixed by centralising the guard in `GenericRepository`.

- **`7789de3a` — assignment read-back gap.** `GetWorkflowDefinitionQueryHandler` (Dapper) never read `WorkflowTransitionAssignments`/`...Clauses`, so clause rules vanished on reload even though the save persisted them (the save *response* projected from the in-memory spec, masking it). Added a 2-query read-back + in-memory join, mirroring the resolver's `GetOutgoingWithAssignmentsAsync`. New integration regression test asserts the round-trip via GetById (the read path), not the mutation response. WorkflowDefinitionsApiTests 9/9.

- **`88be845a` — clause-mode combobox showed raw `"Initiator"`.** `AssignmentClauseMode` was a numeric union (the only one in the FE) but the API serialises enums as strings (`JsonStringEnumConverter`); latent until the read-back fix first fed server data into the editor. Switched to string unions matching the wire contract, consistent with every other FE enum.

**Known issue (now FIXED 2026-05-28):** BP-run start ("Khởi tạo quy trình thất bại") distributed-transaction `NotSupportedException` — resolved by the ambient unit-of-work fix (see the 2026-05-28 entry above). Was pre-existing since Phase 5b (`10ae6203`), unrelated to this arc.

## v2.137p121 — P1 fix: WorkflowTaskFactory pool-task candidate-index producer write gap closed (2026-05-27)

**Type:** fix (P1 data-integrity) | **Scope:** 6 production files + 4 test files + 1 migration + docs | **Status:** SHIPPED. All three phases complete.

**Root cause:** `WorkflowTaskFactory.ApplyCandidateSnapshot` wrote `CandidateRefsJson` but NEVER materialized `WorkflowTaskCandidateIndex` rows. Producer was deferred in S10a (`1b0a9263`) "to a future migration slice" that never landed; Phase 4-C (`ed36ffb0`) then dropped the JSON-read fallback. Every pool task (ByPermission/ByRole/ByGroup/ByOrgUnit) was invisible in inbox and unclaimable — silent P1 data loss for 6 slices.

**Fix (Phase 01 — Producer Materialization):**
- `WorkflowTaskCandidateIndex.CreateForStaging(task, clauseId, combineMode, principalType, principalRefId, tenantId)`: staging factory using nav-prop (not WorkflowTaskId) so EF relationship-fixup propagates the IDENTITY-generated task.Id at SaveChanges time.
- `IWorkflowTaskRepository.StageCandidateIndex(rows)` + impl: `AddRange`, no internal SaveChanges (S7 invariant).
- `WorkflowTaskFactory.ApplyCandidateSnapshot`: for pool tasks (`finalAssignee is null && predicates.Count > 0`), builds one index row per predicate via `CreateForStaging`, calls `StageCandidateIndex`. Single SaveChanges persists task + index rows atomically. Casing: all 4 principal types write UPPER under CI collation.

**Guard (Phase 02 — End-to-End Regression Test):**
- `WorkflowPoolTaskProducerIndexIntegrationTests`: 6 tests, zero manual index seeding. Asserts producer materializes rows on CreateWorkflowInstance path (path A) and ExecuteTransition path (path B); inbox include/exclude; claim 200/403; 2-tenant colliding-ref isolation (RT-3); `CandidateRefsJson` still written alongside rows.
- `InlineWorkflowDefinitionFactory`: `SeedByRoleAssignmentAsync`, `CreateTwoStateWithRoleAssignmentAsync`, `CreateThreeStateWithMixedAssignmentsAsync` (additive helpers, zero modification to existing signatures).
- `ParallelBranchPoolPathGuardTests`: 2 arch-test assertions asserting `ParallelBranchService` does NOT depend on `IWorkflowHandlerResolver` or `IWorkflowTaskFactory` — fail-loud guard against latent pool-on-branch gap resurrection.

**Backfill (Phase 03 — Backfill Migration):**
- Migration `20260527072445_BackfillWorkflowTaskCandidateIndexFromSnapshot`: data-only, OPENJSON-based, inserts one row per predicate for all open/in-progress pool tasks created before the fix. Guards: `IS_MEMBER('db_owner')` RLS bypass, `@migrationStart` bound vs concurrent live producer, soft-delete-aware `NOT EXISTS` idempotency. Down = no-op (forward-only data fix).
- `BackfillWorkflowTaskCandidateIndexMigrationTests`: 4 tests (happy path, idempotency, completed task excluded, assigned task excluded).
- Stale comment in `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler.cs` corrected: explains snapshot = audit/equality value, index rows = queryable read-model, both written in same SaveChanges.

**Tests:** 0E/0W on all affected assemblies (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, WF.Integration, Architecture).

## v2.137p119 — Architecture guard: PublicMetadata wire-cast invariant (T3-WF-BUILDER-ARCH-PUBLICMETADATA-TYPE-RULE) (2026-05-26)

**Type:** test (architecture) | **Scope:** 1 modified file (test-only, +~55 LOC) | **Status:** SHIPPED. Zero production code.

**Forward-looking guard for the default-deny opt-in error envelope (v2.137p117).** The HTTP error envelope (`ApiResponse.Fail`) extracts the reserved `"PublicMetadata"` key via an `is IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>` pattern match — the sole metadata key reaching the wire. `IReadOnlyDictionary` is invariant in TValue, so a bare `Dictionary` or `<string, object>` (non-null) fails the match **silently** → null metadata on the wire (no exception, no log). This rule pins the invariant solution-wide.

**New source-level arch rule (`tests/unit/AqtCoreFW.SharedKernel.Tests/Architecture/SourceLevelRulesTests.cs`):**
- `[Fact] Rule_PublicMetadata_WithMetadata_Value_MustCast_To_IReadOnlyDictionary` — uses existing `SourceCodeScanner.ScanForPattern` (scans `src/**/*.cs`, skips `//`-comment lines, whitelists obj/bin/tests/Migrations/Seeding) to find every `WithMetadata("PublicMetadata", …)` call-site and assert an inline `(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>)` cast. Enforced solution-wide (no allowlist gate — hard wire contract, not a gradual-rollout convention).
- `[Theory]` anti-tautology guard (5 rows): canonical inline cast + whitespace-tight variant → well-typed; missing cast + non-null `<string, object>` TValue → violation; off-scope key → out of scope. Proves the predicate genuinely discriminates rather than passing vacuously.

**Audit-at-slice-start verdict (INVARIANT 260522-A):** row premise had drift — "V11 guards Workflow.Domain" is a *unit test* (`WorkflowGraphValidatorTests.cs:434`) covering the ONE existing call-site (`WorkflowErrors.cs:156`, already correctly cast), not an arch rule; "BP.Domain path unchecked" describes a path that does not exist yet (BP-Activate only carries a comment; wire-surfacing deferred to T3-API-ENVELOPE-FE-BP-ACTIVATE, zero consumers). The rule is thus a forward-looking guard for the future BP-Activate parity path — when it ships, a missing cast REDs here (V11, being factory-specific, would not catch it).

**Tests:** SharedKernel.Tests assembly 199 → 205 (+1 Fact, +5 Theory rows), 0 fail / 0 skip. Full solution build 0E. Code-review APPROVE (all findings Low/Informational; applied the one optional clarity nicety — docstring note that a correctly-typed *named local* still trips the inline-cast rule).

**Docs:** `dependency-map.md` PublicMetadata contract section updated — type invariant documented + carry-fwd "optional arch rule" marked DONE.

## v2.137p118 — Workflow FE: render structured graph-violation metadata + orval RT2-15 client sync (T3-API-ENVELOPE-FE-RENDER) (2026-05-26)

**Type:** feat (FE) + chore (orval regen) | **Scope:** 7 modified files (2 hand-written prod + 1 test + 4 i18n) + 1 NEW generated directory (`user-groups` tag) | **Status:** SHIPPED direct-to-main (2-commit atomic pair via 260523-D policy). Unlocks v2.137p117 BE contract.

**Implements FE consumer for the v2.137p117 default-deny opt-in error envelope.** When workflow graph save/activate returns 422 with `response.errors[0].metadata.violations[*]`, the FE now parses and renders structured violations (rule, stateName, detail, metadata) in a multi-line toast with Vietnamese formatting + i18n keys.

**FE structured-error parsing (hand-written `web/src/core/api/api-error.ts`):**
- NEW `GraphViolation` interface: camelCase props (rule, stateName, transitionActionName, detail); inner `metadata` dict preserves PascalCase keys (e.g. `UnknownGroupCodes`).
- NEW `NormalizedApiError.violations?: GraphViolation[]` field — optional, populated only when BE surfaces the opt-in PublicMetadata envelope.
- `extractViolations()` helper: defensive shape-checking (BE may omit metadata on non-graph errors) + wire-path navigation `errors[0].metadata.violations[*]`.
- `formatGraphViolations()` helper: Vietnamese i18n + multi-line render (caps list at 5 violations to prevent unreadable walls; surfaces `UnknownGroupCodes` inline when present).

**Toast integration (hand-written `web/src/features/workflow/components/use-visual-designer-handlers.ts`):**
- `handleSave` catch block: if `violations.length > 0`, render multi-line toast with `createElement('div', { whiteSpace: 'pre-line' })` wrapper so AntD message doesn't collapse newlines. Duration 8s (vs 4.5s default) for multi-line readability.
- Fallback to generic `t('common.error')` if BE returns 422 without violations (e.g. non-graph validation errors, handled post-v2.137p117 before rendering was wired).

**Internationalization (hand-written `web/src/core/i18n/locales/{vi,en}.json`):**
- `workflow.designer.saveFailed`: "Lưu thất bại — {{count}} vi phạm:" (Vietnamese) / "Save failed — {{count}} violations:" (English). Count passed for pluralization.
- `workflow.designer.unknownGroupCodes`: "Mã nhóm không tồn tại: {{codes}}" / "Unknown group codes: {{codes}}". Codes comma-joined from violation.metadata.UnknownGroupCodes[].
- `workflow.designer.moreViolations`: "…và {{count}} vi phạm khác" / "…and {{count}} more violations". Surfaces when violations.length > 5 (truncation disclosure).

**Orval regen (chore, auto-generated from live API spec :5001):**
- Full `web/src/api/generated/**` — authoritative source. ApiError field `metadata?` now typed correctly from BE schema (was previously unknown). Additive for RT2-15 client sync: new `user-groups` tag + `Workflow.GetInboxQueryHandler` hook re-typed with TenantId param.
- Generated TError default changed from `unknown` → `ProblemDetails` (BE produces RFC 9457 shape, not bare JSON). Full `tsc --noEmit` = 0 (non-breaking, backward-compatible).
- Minor: 6 generated files touched (schemas, workflow-tasks, workflow-assignments, workflow-delegation, workflow-instances, business-processes).

**Tests (`web/src/test/api/api-error.test.ts` NEW, 6 facts):**
- T1: `extractViolations` null-safe (metadata absent, undefined, not-object, violations not array) → undefined return.
- T2: `extractViolations` with 1 violation → parsed correctly (camelCase props preserved, PascalCase metadata keys untouched).
- T3: `formatGraphViolations` caps list at 5, appends "+N more" footer.
- T4: `formatGraphViolations` with UnknownGroupCodes — merges codes into unknownGroupCodes i18n key inline.
- T5: `unknownGroupCodes` helper extracts array from violation.metadata.UnknownGroupCodes (defensive string-coerce).
- T6: `normalizeError` with no violations field in firstError → violations field in returned NormalizedApiError = undefined.

**Tests (FE integration via Vitest):** Full FE suite 891 pass / 14 fail (all 14 pre-existing T3-FE-TESTS-DRIFT jsdom getComputedStyle, 0 new regression). tsc 0 / eslint 0 / build clean.

**Wire contract locked by:** `WorkflowByGroupProducerAndSaveValidationTests.cs` I4/I5 (v2.137p117) — violations list shape asserted at both JSON + typed-DTO boundaries (C# + FE now symmetric).

**BP-Activate parity:** Deferred to follow-up row T3-API-ENVELOPE-FE-BP-ACTIVATE. Handler sets only internal GraphErrors (not wired v2.137p117); when wired, FE consumer already exists (same `handleSave` path as Workflow).

## v2.137p117 — SharedKernel: ApiError structured metadata envelope + ByGroup violations wire (T3-API-ENVELOPE-STRUCTURED-VIOLATIONS Slice B) (2026-05-26)

**Type:** feat (SharedKernel contract extension + Workflow domain) | **Scope:** 4 code/test files (2 SharedKernel, 1 Workflow domain, 1 unit test, 1 integration test) + docs | **Status:** SHIPPED direct-to-main (single-SHA per 260523-D). BE-only; FE rendering deferred (see below).

**Adds DEFAULT-DENY OPT-IN structured metadata to the API error envelope (additive, backward-compatible).** Only errors that explicitly set the reserved `"PublicMetadata"` key in FluentResults metadata surface structured data in the wire response; all other internal keys are stripped at the `Fail()` boundary.

**SharedKernel contract changes (blast-radius: every endpoint's error envelope):**
- `ApiError.cs`: added optional `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? Metadata = null` (6th positional param). `[property: JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull)]` ensures `"metadata":null` never appears in error JSON — required because `AddJsonOptions` sets no global `WhenWritingNull`.
- `ApiResponse.cs` `Fail()`: extracts `"PublicMetadata"` key from FluentResults `IError.Metadata` into `ApiError.Metadata`. Inline comment documents `IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey,TValue>` invariant TValue trap (producer MUST cast to `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>` for the `is` pattern match to succeed at runtime).

**Workflow domain: `WorkflowErrors.GraphValidationFailed` envelopes violations:**
- `"GraphErrors"` key: INTERNAL raw violations list (for logs/debug only, never surfaces on HTTP response).
- `"PublicMetadata"` key: `{ violations: [ { Rule, StateName, TransitionActionName, Detail, Metadata } ] }` — wire-safe projection. `Metadata` per violation carries rule-specific data (e.g. `UnknownGroupCodes` from ByGroup Q2 check).
- `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>` explicit cast on Dictionary producer prevents runtime type-match failure.
- Error message updated: `"See metadata.violations for per-rule details."` (was `"See GraphErrors for details."`).

**Wire shape:** `response.errors[0].metadata.violations[*].metadata.UnknownGroupCodes` — `metadata` camelCase from record prop, `violations` lowercase dict key, `Metadata` as-is violation prop, `UnknownGroupCodes` as-is inner dict key.

**Tests:**
- `WorkflowGraphValidatorTests.cs` (unit): `V11` extended with `PublicMetadata` key presence + IReadOnlyDictionary type assertion (invariant trap regression guard) + violations list shape assertions.
- `WorkflowByGroupProducerAndSaveValidationTests.cs` (integration): I4/I5 re-enabled with full `metadata.violations` wire assertions. NEW `ExtractPublicViolationsAsync` helper (navigates camelCase JSON path). I5 made self-contained (`SeedActiveGroupAsync("GROUP_TEST_A")` at test start — fixes xUnit non-ordering dependency on I1).

**FE deferred (cut surfaced, not silently absorbed):** scout found no existing structured-error display pattern — `normalizeError` in `api-error.ts` strips all fields to a fixed `NormalizedApiError` shape, and `handleSave` uses a generic `appMessage.error(t('common.error'))`. Rendering structured violations needs a NEW UX decision (modal / inline / toast-expandable). The full FE arc (orval regen from the updated BE spec + a violations renderer) is filed as follow-up `T3-API-ENVELOPE-FE-RENDER`. The BE contract is additive opt-in and ships standalone with zero current consumer (no regression).

**BP-Activate parity deferred:** `ActivateBusinessProcessCommandHandler` sets only the internal `GraphErrors` key (never wire-surfaced — before OR after this slice; the old `Fail()` never extracted it either, so no regression). Giving BP-Activate the same structured-violation wire surface is folded into `T3-API-ENVELOPE-FE-RENDER` (symmetric with the FE deferral; zero consumer today). The handler comment was corrected (it previously implied GraphErrors reached the FE).

**Tests (full cross-assembly gate, no `--filter`):** WF.App **585/585** / WF.Integration **63/67** (4 pre-existing skips; I4+I5 wire assertions GREEN) / SharedKernel **199/199** / Contracts **41/41** / Architecture **105/105** / Identity.Integration **212/212** / Forms.Integration **9/9** / BusinessProcess.Integration **2/2** = **1216/1220 pass, 0 fail**. Debug build **0E/0W**; pre-existing CS4014 in Release `TreatWarningsAsErrors` config unrelated (present at HEAD before this slice). ## v2.137p107 — BusinessProcess: ReplaceFormMaps production fix + ClientCascade FK configuration (T3-BP-FORMMAP-REPRO) (2026-05-24)

**Type:** fix (EF configuration + repository orphan handling) | **Scope:** 3 source files + 1 EF migration + NEW integration test project (5 files) | **Status:** SHIPPED `[commits pending]` direct-to-main

**Root Cause:** EF Core 10 + SQL Server batch sorter emits INSERT before DELETE for same-table operations within a single SaveChanges transaction, colliding with 3-column unique indexes on `BusinessProcessStateForms` and `BusinessProcessTransitionForms` when `ReplaceFormMaps` handler calls `bp.ClearStateForms() + bp.ClearTransitionForms()` followed by re-adding identical `(BpId, StateId/TransitionId, FormTemplateId)` triples. Bug latent since v2.137p62 (2026-05-17), surfaced by T3-BP-FORMMAP-REPLACE-TEST TDD spike (commit 5c387ea0).

**Fix (Combined Approach):**
1. **EF Configuration:** Changed `DeleteBehavior.Cascade` → `DeleteBehavior.ClientCascade` for `BusinessProcessDefinition.StateForms` + `.TransitionForms` navigation properties. Structural cleanup: BP aggregates are soft-delete-only, so DB-side cascade was cosmetic artifact.
2. **EF Migration:** New migration `20260523234630_ChangeBpFormMapsCascadeToClientCascade` drops 2 foreign keys with `ON DELETE CASCADE` + re-adds without cascade (additive, reversible). Migration idempotency + rollback safe.
3. **Repository Orphan Filter:** Rewrote `BusinessProcessRepository.UpdateAsync` persistence boundary (lines 76–155): collects orphaned children (Unchanged or Deleted state, Id>0, not in aggregate's current collection) → `ExecuteDeleteAsync` for explicit orphan removal → detach from tracker → standard SaveChanges INSERT, all wrapped in `IDbContextTransaction` (S7 invariant). Keeps aggregate API and handler oblivious to EF Core snapshot change detection quirk on encapsulated IReadOnlyList<T> navigation surfaces.

**New Integration Test Project:** `tests/integration/AqtCoreFW.BusinessProcess.Integration.Tests` (NEW csproj registered in `.slnx`).
- **F1 (anti-regression):** ReplaceFormMaps with identical form triples (state + transition) — before fix: 2601 unique index violation (500); after fix: 200 OK, DB rows updated atomically.
- **F2 (anti-tautology, 260522-E pattern):** Verifies orphan-filter is SCOPED (removes only actual orphans), not blanket (does not delete all children). Principal test: add Form A, replace with Form B (orphan-deletes A, inserts B), add Form C (regression: C must NOT be deleted). Without the scoping guard, a buggy blanket-delete would also pass F1 (vacuously true: all children deleted before insert).

**Files Changed:**
- `src/modules/businessprocess/AqtCoreFW.BusinessProcess.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/BusinessProcessDefinitionConfiguration.cs` (DeleteBehavior flip, +comment)
- `src/modules/businessprocess/AqtCoreFW.BusinessProcess.Infrastructure/Persistence/Migrations/20260523234630_ChangeBpFormMapsCascadeToClientCascade.cs` (+ Designer.cs + ModelSnapshot update)
- `src/modules/businessprocess/AqtCoreFW.BusinessProcess.Infrastructure/Repositories/BusinessProcessRepository.cs` (UpdateAsync rewrite with orphan-filter + TX wrap)
- `src/AqtCoreFW.slnx` (register new test project)
- `tests/integration/AqtCoreFW.BusinessProcess.Integration.Tests/{csproj, SqlServerCollectionLocal.cs, Repositories/BusinessProcessRepositoryFormMapsTests.cs}` (NEW test project, F1+F2)

**Tests:** F1 + F2 2/2 GREEN (integration suite Testcontainers SQL), BP.App 94/94, BP.Infra 2/2, Architecture 105/105, full solution 0E/0W.

**Code-review:** APPROVE 9.3/10 (0 Crit / 0 High / 2 Med carry-fwd: L1 comment cosmetic phrasing, L2 future orphan-filter audit kit). New integration test project anchors regression surface; EF configuration mirrors existing precedent (V2 aggregate FK patterns).

**Decisions:**
- Path C (EF config flip + migration + repository boundary workaround) chosen over Path A (nav-prop refactor) — smaller blast radius, zero impact on aggregate API or handler contracts.
- Explicit ExecuteDeleteAsync at persistence boundary (vs relying on EF cascade) — defensive: SQL Server batching behavior is implementation-detail; explicit control survives engine version bumps.
- Integration test project created (vs inline BP.Infra test) — validates end-to-end persistence flow; Testcontainers SQL catches real batch-order issues unit-mock cannot see.

**Carry-fwd:** None. v2.137p62 dormant bug closed atomically. T3-BP-FORMMAP-REPRO backlog row closed.

**Cycle:** ~7h session (TDD spike 5c387ea0 found bug; Path C impl ~2.5h + test sweep + code-review). Root-cause discovery latent since 2026-05-17; remediation deferred until TDD coverage forced surface.

## v2.137p105 — Workflow: silent-strip Assignment on recall transitions (T3-WF-RECALL Option A) (2026-05-23)

**Type:** fix (handler semantic) | **Scope:** 3 files (1 handler + 2 tests) | **Status:** SHIPPED `031d0cc1` direct-to-main

Closes T3-WF-RECALL-ASSIGNMENT-Q (P2 product-input row filed earlier today during plan 260523-1241 closure). Product Q ratified 2026-05-23 = Option A silent-strip server-side: when FE sends `{"isRecall": true, "assignment": {...}}`, handler drops the assignment to null before passing to repo. Validator R2-R4 already exempt recall transitions, so any payload sent would persist as dead-data in `WorkflowTransitionAssignments` (never resolved by handler-resolver pipeline).

**Implementation:** single-LOC at `SaveDefinitionGraphCommandHandler.cs:91-94` — `Assignment = t.IsRecall ? null : MapAssignment(t.Assignment)`. Comment cross-refs the product Q. Keeps `MapAssignment` helper free of business rule (SRP — DTO mapping vs strip rule).

**Tests:** WF.App unit suite 6/6→7/7 (new `H_A7_RecallTransitionWithNonNullAssignment_SilentlyStripsToNullBeforeRepo` — Received(1).ReplaceGraphAsync(...) with Recall.Assignment==null despite non-null input). Workflow.Integration scoped suite 5/5→6/6 (new `I_SaveAct_A6_RecallTransitionWithAssignment_PersistsNoAssignmentRow` — Testcontainers SQL: 3-state graph + non-null assignment on Recall → 200 + DB shows zero assignment rows for recall transition + regression guard `nonRecallAssignmentCount==2` proving strip is scoped not blanket).

**Code-review:** APPROVE 9.4/10 (0 Crit / 0 High / 0 Med / 2 Low FE-UX carry-fwd).

**Anti-tautology (260522-E):** H_A7 proves NECESSARY ABSENCE (`Assignment==null` at repo with non-null input). I_SaveAct_A6 + `nonRecallAssignmentCount==2` regression guard proves strip is SCOPED to recall, not blanket — without the guard, a buggy `Assignment = null` (unconditional) would also satisfy absence assertion.

**Carry-fwd (Low, non-blocking):** FE-FU — grey-out `<Collapse>` Phân quyền hành động on `transition.IsRecall===true` edges for UX clarity. Server is already authoritative; FE polish only.

**Closes 1 of 8 carry-fwd rows filed in v2.137p104.** 7 carry-fwd rows remain open (incl 2 more P2 product-input rows: T3-WF-EMPTY-CLAUSES-Q, T3-WF-DEFAULT-CLAUSE-MODE-Q).

## v2.137p87 — Workflow: Phase 4-B Claim + Unclaim + Concurrent-Race (2026-05-21)

**Type:** Feature | **Scope:** Self-assign (pool-eligible only) + concurrent-race pool-safety + rowversion contention handling | **Status:** SHIPPED (feat/phase-04-slice-b-claim-unclaim-concurrent, `6eeaa057` LOCAL, code-review APPROVE-WITH-NITS 9.2/10).

### Summary

- **Claim endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/workflow/tasks/{id}/claim` self-assigns task if caller is pool-eligible (permission-code match + TenantId + principal in candidates). New `WorkflowErrorCodes.AlreadyClaimed = "GOV_WFL_016"` (409) returned on (a) domain guard: `task.Status` not Open, or (b) concurrent claim: another actor claimed task between fetch + save (rowversion mismatch, DbUpdateConcurrencyException), or (c) pool-ineligible: caller lacks required permission code.
- **Pool-eligibility check fires before mutation:** `IsPoolEligibleAsync(taskId, tenantId, ct)` evaluates `PrincipalType=Permission ∩ TenantId ∩ permissionCodes.Contains(PrincipalRefId)` to return 403 before handler calls domain `Claim()`, preventing information leak (clean 403 instead of domain-guard 409).
- **Concurrent-race mechanism non-deterministic (F3):** Two concurrent claims may exercise either domain `InvalidOperationException` path (sequential fetch, first wins) or `DbUpdateConcurrencyException` path (parallel fetch, second loses rowversion), but both translate to identical user-facing 409 + `GOV_WFL_016`. Advisory comment added to test (H1 Option C carry-forward: deterministic unit test via `ISaveChangesInterceptor` deferred to 4-C).
- **Unclaim endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/workflow/tasks/{id}/unclaim` releases task assignment to pool if caller is current assignee. Idempotent: if task not assigned, returns 200 OK without audit write (F5 pattern — short-circuits before `assignmentRepository.AddAsync`). Status reverts to `Open`.
- **New infrastructure methods:** `IWorkflowTaskRepository.IsPoolEligibleAsync(…)` + `UpdateWithClaimGuardAsync(…)` (catches `DbUpdateConcurrencyException` at Infrastructure boundary, zero EF leak to Application per S7 invariant).
- **Audit trail:** `TaskAssignment` ledger captures both Claim (new type enum) and Unclaim (idempotent skips audit). No new migrations — existing schema supports both.

### Tests

6 integration facts in `WorkflowTasksClaimTests.cs` + `WorkflowTasksUnclaimTests.cs`:
- **F1:** Claim with pool-ineligible caller → 403 (clean gate before handler invocation)
- **F2:** Claim when `task.Status != Open` → 409 + `GOV_WFL_016` (domain guard)
- **F3:** Concurrent Claim (two tasks.WhenAll) → 200 + 409 (rowversion contention, advisory comment for H1 carry-fwd)
- **F4:** Unclaim when task not assigned → 200 OK (idempotent, no-op)
- **F5:** Unclaim when assigned → 200 OK, audit-count unchanged (idempotent short-circuit verified)
- **F6:** Anon request to Claim → 401 baseline (proves route registered + 403 from auth, not config)

All gates: Build 0E/0W. Workflow.Application 493/493, Workflow.Integration 33p/1f (pre-existing), Domain 145/145. Tests enforce S5 META-L (c) anti-tautology: F1/F4 DB assertions + F3 audit-count load-bearing.

### Notes

- **Code-review:** APPROVE-WITH-NITS 9.2/10, 0 Crit/1 High(advisory)/3 Med(defer)/3 Low(defer).
- **H1 Advisory:** F3 race mechanism non-deterministic (both outcomes identical to user). Recommend Option C (advisory comment in test) + Option B (deterministic unit test via ISaveChangesInterceptor) defer to 4-C.
- **M1 Carry-forward:** Claim against Done/Cancelled task collapses to `GOV_WFL_016` (should discriminate `InvalidStateError`). Recommend 4-C split exception handling or unify error code at domain level.
- **M2/M3 Cosmetic:** Duplicate `instancePublicId` lookups in both handlers (accept for now, future cleanup).

## v2.137p81 — Workflow: Phase 3 Slice 9 EscalationCheckJob Pool-Safety + Pool-Aging (2026-05-20)

**Type:** Bug-fix + Feature | **Scope:** `EscalationCheckJob.cs` (pool-safety steal-fix RT2-7 + log-only aging RT3-M3); 5 new integration tests | **Status:** SHIPPED (feat/process-handler-resolution-p3, `b8cdee46` LOCAL no-push).

### Summary

- **RT2-7 steal-fix:** Added `AND t.AssigneeId IS NOT NULL` SQL filter to escalation pass so pool tasks (AssigneeId=null) are excluded. Belt-and-braces `if (row.AssigneeId is null) continue;` guard defends against future SQL drift. Pool tasks NEVER receive `TaskAssignment(Escalation)` ledger rows or `task.Assign()` calls.
- **RT3-M3 pool-aging (mandatory):** Integrated 2nd pass emits structured `LogWarning` per pool task unclaimed ≥ 60 min (`PoolAgingThresholdMinutes = 60`). Log-only — no DB mutation, no event, no ledger row. Two passes are disjoint by design: Pass 1 = `AssigneeId IS NOT NULL`; Pass 2 = `AssigneeId IS NULL`.
- **Restructure:** Early-exit `if (count == 0) return;` replaced with nested `if (count > 0) { ...save... }` so aging pass always runs regardless of escalation results (required for A3 correctness — planner deviation documented).
- **EF drift:** None — aging is purely log-based; `dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes` = "No changes".

### Tests

5 new integration facts in `Jobs/EscalationCheckJobPoolSafetyTests.cs`:
- **A1** — Pool task overdue + matching rule → steal-fix: `AssigneeId.BeNull()` + `ledgerCount==0` (non-tautological: `EscalateToValue` is parsable Guid proving `task.Assign()` WOULD have fired without fix)
- **A2** — Single-assigned overdue → escalates normally (regression bar unchanged legacy path)
- **A3** — Pool task ≥ 60 min unclaimed → `LogWarning` + no ledger + `AssigneeId.BeNull()` + `UpdatedAt.BeNull()` (RT3-M3 no audit-update side-effect)
- **A4** — Pool task < 60 min → no aging log (threshold SQL predicate)
- **A5** — Co-existence: both passes run same invocation without crossover (RT2-7 + RT3-M3 orthogonality)

### Summary

- **Task-creation seam (DSEAM-a):** When `ExecuteTransitionCommand.NextHandlerUserId` is null AND final state, else-branch materializes `WorkflowTask` via new `IWorkflowTaskRepository.Stage(instanceId, targetStateId, tenantId, ct)` method (no-save). - **Override gate (DLIVE-b 4-gate flow):** (a) null NextHandlerUserId → skip assignment override + log-info fallthrough to resolver-only path; (b) non-null NextHandlerUserId + target transition has `AllowAssignorOverride=true` → (c) call `IIdentityModuleClient.GetUserActiveStatusAsync` (live IsActive/!IsLockedOut check, no cache); (d) call `ResolverAuthz.IsActorAuthorized(override actor, target assignment pool permissions)` for inclusion validation; success → assign task to NextHandlerUserId via new `IWorkflowTaskRepository.AssignAsync(taskId, userId, tenantId, ct)`, fail → result.Fail(Unauthorized).

NextHandlerUserId = null` (LAST, optional positional, backward-compatible); `ExecuteTransitionRequest` (Workflow HTTP DTO) + `ExecuteTransitionRequest` (SharedKernel.Contracts wire-format, both carry same field); `ExecuteBusinessProcessTransitionCommand` (BP handler accepts and threads through to Workflow client). 7 layers wired: FE → API controller → HTTP DTO → MediatR command → handler → Application service → Infrastructure client call.

## v2.137p78 / p78.1 — Workflow: Phase 3 Slice 7 Defer-Save Split + M1/M2 Close (2026-05-20)

**Type:** Feature (transactional boundary hardening, M1/M2 finalization) | **Scope:** `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler` defer-save flow split, `IWorkflowInstanceRepository` (3 new primitives: UpdateWithStateGuardNoSaveAsync, SaveChangesAsync, ClearChanges), new `StateConflictAtBoundary()` factory, dead `IParallelBranchService.PersistStagedBranchAsync` removal, M1 defensive ClearChanges on early-return paths + L1 HasAmbientTransaction XML cross-ref | **Status:** SHIPPED (feat/process-handler-resolution-p3, v2.137p78 + v2.137p78.1 LOCAL no-push, atomic-at-merge).

ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler defer-save flow refactored into 2-phase: (1) UpdateWithStateGuardNoSaveAsync validates state + composes side-effects (no persistence), returns Result<UpdateWithStateGuardOutput>; (2) SaveChangesAsync persists single flush (ChangeTracker.SaveChanges → Task<Result<int>>, translates DbUpdateConcurrencyException→Result.Fail internally). GOV_WFL_013 (StateConflict, 409) surface relocates from Repo:144 inner-save to ETR outer-save boundary (cooperative-rollback contract: caller MUST inspect result.IsSuccess BEFORE completing ambient TransactionScope, per S6 RT3-FM-F4). M1 Defensive: ClearChanges() added to both catch blocks (BranchFanOutException + generic) AND both early-return rollback paths (UpdateWithStateGuardNoSaveAsync IsFailed + SaveChangesAsync IsFailed) — ensures stale entities purged post-rollback before re-attempt (v2.137p78.1 augment). M2 Cooperative-rollback contract: XML <remarks> on Handle + <seealso> cross-refs from IWorkflowTransaction + HasAmbientTransaction (plan R5 documentation deferred S6, fulfilled S7.1). Dead code: IParallelBranchService.PersistStagedBranchAsync removed (staged entities remain EF-tracked, single outer SaveChanges absorbs all post-S6 single-tx model).

### Summary
**Production code changes:**
- `IWorkflowInstanceRepository` (contract): `UpdateWithStateGuardNoSaveAsync(long instanceId, Guid tenantId, Guid actorId, long? targetStateId, ct) → Task<Result<UpdateWithStateGuardOutput>>` (NEW); `SaveChangesAsync(ct) → Task<Result<int>>` (NEW, returns affected rows, translates DbUpdateConcurrencyException internally); `ClearChanges() → void` (NEW, ChangeTracker.Clear for stale-entry cleanup post-rollback).
- `IWorkflowInstanceRepository.HasAmbientTransaction` XML: Added <remarks> documenting cooperative-rollback contract + <seealso>ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler</seealso> cross-ref (S7.1 fulfillment).
- `WorkflowErrors`: `StateConflictAtBoundary() → ValidationError` factory (NEW, sibling to existing StateConflict(Guid id), same GOV_WFL_013 code, caller-side context explicit in error name).
- `IParallelBranchService` (contract): Removed `PersistStagedBranchAsync(branchInstanceId, tenantId, ct) → Task` method. Dead since S6 single-tx model.
- `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler.Handle`: (Step 5) Call UpdateWithStateGuardNoSaveAsync → inspect result.IsFailed → early-return RollbackAsync + ClearChanges (L1); (Step 6) Call SaveChangesAsync → inspect result.IsFailed → early-return RollbackAsync + ClearChanges (S7.1 M1 fill); (Step 7) old SaveChanges removed; propagate to finally-dispose pattern. Both catch blocks (BranchFanOut + generic Exception) now call ClearChanges() with try/catch + LogWarning wrapping (S7.1 M1 augment).

**Test coverage (v2.137p78):**

## v2.137p77 / p77.1 — Workflow: Phase 3 Slice 6 ETR Atomic-Tx Refactor (2026-05-20)

**Type:** Feature (transactional model shift, BREAKING for callers relying on best-effort branching) | **Scope:** `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler` (main tx envelope + remove swallow-catch), `IWorkflowInstanceRepository` (2 new methods: HasAmbientTransaction, BeginTransactionAsync), new Application abstraction IWorkflowTransaction, new error code GOV_WFL_015 (422), 2 new integration test files (H1 + H2 coverage fixes), 0 DB migrations | **Status:** SHIPPED (feat/process-handler-resolution-p3, v2.137p77 main + v2.137p77.1 test coverage augment, LOCAL atomic-at-merge).

ETR `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler` single SaveChanges under ambient-enlist tx envelope. Branch fan-out failure now rolls back the entire transition (was: silent-swallow best-effort). If no ambient TransactionScope, ETR opens its own DB transaction with fail-CLOSED rollback on any exception. If ambient enlistment detected (TransactionScope.Required or db.Database.CurrentTransaction active), ETR defers commit/rollback to caller. New `IWorkflowTransaction` Application-layer abstraction (Infrastructure implementation EfWorkflowTransaction) preserves boundary. New public-facing error: `GOV_WFL_015 BranchFanOutFailed` (422 ValidationError, distinct from GOV_WFL_014 workflow-misconfiguration). Ambient-detection dual-check: `Transaction.Current != null` (MSDTC canonical) OR `db.Database.CurrentTransaction != null` (EF direct tx).

### Summary
**Production code changes:**
- `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler`: Insert ambient-enlist guard + tx envelope at start of write phase (before UpdateWithStateGuardAsync call). Remove @ line 226 `await branchService.PersistStagedBranchAsync(...)` (staged entities remain tracked, single outer SaveChanges absorbs all). Remove @ lines 229-233 swallow-catch (now propagates to outer try, triggering rollback on failure).
- `IWorkflowInstanceRepository` (contract): `HasAmbientTransaction() → bool`, `BeginTransactionAsync(ct) → IWorkflowTransaction`.
- `IWorkflowTransaction` (new Application contract): `CommitAsync(ct) → Task`, `RollbackAsync(ct) → Task`, `Dispose()`.
- `EfWorkflowTransaction` (Infrastructure): Private wrapper adapter around `IDbContextTransaction`.

**New public error contract:**
- `WorkflowErrorCodes.BranchFanOutFailed = "GOV_WFL_015"` (new error code).
- `WorkflowErrors.BranchFanOutFailed(Guid instancePublicId) → ValidationError` (factory method, 422).
- Emitted by ETR when `BranchFanOutException` (private sentinel) caught after `InitiateBranchingAsync` exception. Distinct from `GOV_WFL_014` (workflow misconfiguration) and `GOV_WFL_004` (invalid transition).

**Behavior change (RT3-FM-F4 restored):**
- Pre-Slice-6: Branch fan-out failure → transition succeeds, child tasks missing → eventual escalation/inbox catches.
- Post-Slice-6: Branch fan-out failure → **transition rolled back** → client sees HTTP 422 `GOV_WFL_015`.
- **Public-facing contract delta:** Callers wrapping ETR in `TransactionScope.Required` MUST inspect `result.IsSuccess` BEFORE `scope.Complete()` to cooperatively rollback on failure. XML doc added (M2 deferred to follow-up per code-reviewer).

**Test coverage (v2.137p77.1 augment, commit ec4e5b4c):**
- H1: `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandlerTests.Handle_BranchFanOut_InitiateBranchingThrows_MapsToGOV_WFL_015` (unit, 1 fact) — mocks `branchService.InitiateBranchingAsync` to throw, asserts `result.Errors[GOV_WFL_015]` + `txMock.Received(1).RollbackAsync()`.
- H2: `WorkflowInstanceRepositoryAmbientTransactionTests` (integration, 3 facts) — real `TransactionScope` + `db.Database.CurrentTransaction` exercises both OR-branches of ambient-detection logic. Precondition asserts pin which code-path was taken (not tautology).
- A1-A4 from planner + original commit: rollback integration, AND/OR/NofM regression, concurrency 409 bar.

### Verification
- **Build:** 0 errors (new repo contract methods auto-mocked by test doubles).
- **Test:** 481 unit (was 480, +1 H1) + 3 integration H2 + A1-A4 (all GREEN). Worktree-diff vs 508ed525 (Slice 5 baseline) confirms no new regressions.
- **Fail-CLOSED shape:** `try { ... commit } catch { rollback; throw/return-fail } finally { dispose }` verified per S5 META-L (e).
- **Ambient guard:** Both `Transaction.Current` and `Ctx.Database.CurrentTransaction` checked (R1 mitigation).
- **BP-path:** `scope.Complete()` gated by `if (!execOutcome.IsSuccess)` in ExecuteBusinessProcessTransitionCommandHandler + StartBusinessProcessRunCommandHandler (no double-commit).

### Notes
- **Carry-forward to Slice 7:** UpdateWithStateGuardAsync defer-save SPLIT (decision D1-α deferred), 409 mapping relocation (paired with split), XML doc on cooperative-rollback contract (M2).
- **Medium findings (code-review):** M1 dirty change-tracker on failure (deferred), M2 XML doc (deferred), M3 catch-clause ordering comment (deferred), M4 attachment-rollback test variant (deferred). All noted for Slice 7 follow-up; fail-CLOSED shape correct.

## v2.137p76 — Workflow: Phase 3 Session-3 Slice 5 Model-B Resolver Fail-CLOSED Authz Gate (2026-05-20)

**Type:** Feature (security, authorization model shift) | **Scope:** 1 new repo method (GetOutgoingWithAssignmentsAsync), 3 handlers with fine-grained assignment-rule authz gates, 1 new error code (GOV_WFL_014/422), 1 new shared service (ResolverAuthz), 0 DB migrations | **Status:** UNCOMMITTED (feat/process-handler-resolution-p3, Slices 6-11 pending atomic merge).

Model-B resolver fail-CLOSED authorization gate on 3 execute surfaces (ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler, GetAvailableTransitionsQueryHandler, ResolveBranchChildCommandHandler). Replaces coarse task.Process RPC surface-level gate (p73) with fail-CLOSED resolver on target state: if target non-final AND no handler resolved from assignment rules → 422 GOV_WFL_014 (workflow misconfiguration distinct from authz 403). New repo method feeds resolver gate. Recall transitions carve out (creator-guard is recall authz; resolver excludes IsRecall=true). RPC column LIVE (drop deferred P3 M2 post-merge).

### Summary
**New public repository method:**
- `IWorkflowDefinitionRepository.GetOutgoingWithAssignmentsAsync(long stateId, CancellationToken) → IReadOnlyList<WorkflowTransition>`: 2-query + in-memory left-join on TransitionId. Queries: (1) WorkflowTransition by FromStateId; (2) WorkflowTransitionAssignment + clauses by TransitionId set. Returns transitions with eager-loaded Clauses (no-tracking, AsReadOnly). Feeds resolver-gate decision point (can we resolve a handler for this state+transition combo?).

**New error contract:**
- `WorkflowErrorCodes.NoHandlerResolved = "GOV_WFL_014"` (new error code).
- `WorkflowErrors.NoHandlerResolved(long stateId) → ValidationError` (factory method).
- HTTP status: **422 Unprocessable Entity** (distinct from 403 authz; indicates workflow def misconfiguration — non-final target with zero-handler pool).

**Fine-grained authz on 3 handlers:**
1. `ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler`: Pre-execution check via resolver on target state (coarse p73 gate still active; fine-grained gate new). IF target non-final AND resolver returns empty pool → 422 GOV_WFL_014. IF resolver returns candidates → authz-of-chosen assignment rule (test assigner permission against transition's own assignment rule + live actor status via IIdentityModuleClient).
2. `GetAvailableTransitionsQueryHandler`: Symmetry — visibility filter mirrors executor authz (transitions whose resolved handlers include current actor).
3. `ResolveBranchChildCommandHandler`: Continuation resolver gate on branch-child transition target state (fail-CLOSED). Ensures child completion → state not entered without handler.

**New shared service:**
- `AqtCoreFW.Workflow.Application.Services.ResolverAuthz`: Helper encapsulating fine-grained assignment-rule authz evaluation (factored from resolver execution). DI-registered in `WorkflowApplicationModule`.
- `WorkflowHandlerResolver` now DI-registered (was manual in-memory instantiation p71-p72).

**Recall carve-out:**
- Transitions with `IsRecall=true` bypass resolver gate (creator-guard is only authz boundary; resolved handlers irrelevant). Resolver explicitly excludes IsRecall=true from gate evaluation.

**RPC column divergence (deferred drop):**
- DB column `[workflow].[WorkflowTransition].[RequiredPermissionCode]` LIVE (p75 code-side strip, p76 resolver gate, migration drop deferred P3 M2 post-merge for rollback safety).
- EF model field already removed (p75); assignment rules now primary (p74 backfill idempotent).

- **Test:** Pending integration (depends on handler wiring — Slices 6+).
- **Recall:** Explicit `where t.IsRecall == false` in resolver gate (carve-out confirmed).
- **Branch state:** feat/process-handler-resolution-p3, uncommitted. Slice 5 only (Slices 6-11 pending merge-gate approval).

## v2.137p72 — Workflow: Phase 2b ParallelBranchService Stage-Only Prep (2026-05-19)

**Type:** Feature (service refactor, interim behavior-preserving) | **Scope:** 1 interface method added (IParallelBranchService.PersistStagedBranchAsync), 1 method behavior changed (InitiateBranchingAsync now stage-only), 1 handler updated (ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler) | **Status:** SHIPPED & INTEGRATED.

Refactor parallel branching service for Phase 3 single-transaction model: `InitiateBranchingAsync` now stages entities without persisting; `PersistStagedBranchAsync` persists staged state. Interim behavior byte-identical pre-P3 (ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler invokes persist immediately after stage). P3 will fold persist into outer transaction boundary.

### Summary
**Interface change (IParallelBranchService):**
- `InitiateBranchingAsync`: STAGE-ONLY (no internal SaveChangesAsync). Creates WorkflowInstanceBranchStatus + per-child WorkflowBranchChild + per-child WorkflowTask in change tracker; transitions status to InProgress; returns branch status.
- `PersistStagedBranchAsync`: NEW method. Flushes staged entities to DB via SaveChangesAsync. Interim (P2b): called immediately by ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler after InitiateBranchingAsync. P3: drops this call; single transaction wraps both stage and persist.

**Handler change (ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler):**
- Lines 148-153: After InitiateBranchingAsync returns, invoke PersistStagedBranchAsync before continue. Swallow-all try/catch unchanged (branching optional; transition already committed).

**Method signatures (unchanged):**
- `ResolveBranchChildAsync`: Untouched.
- `CheckJoinCondition`: Untouched.

**Schema:** No new entities, no migration, no RLS policy additions.

**Cross-module impact:** Zero (no new dependencies; WorkflowInstanceBranchStatus remains internal to Workflow module).

### Verification
- IParallelBranchService interface: 4 members (InitiateBranchingAsync, PersistStagedBranchAsync, ResolveBranchChildAsync, CheckJoinCondition).
- ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler compiles; branching block lines 138-161 intact (stage → persist → catch).
- Build 0 warnings/errors.

### Notes
- **Interim semantics:** All-or-nothing preserved (stage → immediate persist within swallow-all block). Combined failure of either stage or persist → silent continue (same pre-P3 behavior).
- **P3 atomicity:** Single transaction will replace this two-call pattern. Both ExecuteTransitionCommandHandler + P3 atomic PR will have access to scoped DbContext; no persist call needed at handler level.
- **RT3-FM-F4:** All-or-nothing behavior change belongs to P3 (transaction scope) and beyond, not here.

### Closes
**Closes: Process-Handler-Resolution Phase 2b ParallelBranchService stage-only prep** — Refactored service boundary for P3 single-transaction model; interim behavior unchanged.

## v2.137p69 — Auth: deep-link/refresh no longer bounces to `/` (2026-05-18)

**Type:** Fix (auth UX, global) | **Scope:** 1 FE file, +6/-1 | **Status:** SHIPPED (code-review 9.5/10, live-verified).

`RouteGuard` (`web/src/features/auth/route-guard.tsx`) called `userManager.signinRedirect()` with no `state`, so on hard-load/refresh of any deep authenticated route the OIDC round-trip lost the target and `callback-page.tsx` fell back to `?? '/'` → every deep-link/refresh bounced to the dashboard. Fix: pass `{ state: { returnUrl: window.location.pathname + window.location.search } }`; `callback-page.tsx` already consumed `state.returnUrl` behind a relative-path open-redirect guard (`startsWith('/') && !startsWith('//')`) — no consumer change. Not BP-specific (surfaced via the run wizard). Open-redirect not exploitable (producer emits only browser-normalized pathname+search); OIDC anti-forgery `state`/`nonce` unaffected (oidc-client-ts treats the arg as user-state).

## v2.137p68 — BP MVP Intake Data Integrity: 3-Part Fix Chain (2026-05-18)

**Type:** Bug fix (FE contract + BE data integrity + domain helpers) | **Scope:** 6 files (2 FE, 2 BE Domain, 2 BE Handlers/Tests) | **Impact:** Form template snapshots now paired with Publish; BP intake validation fail-fast; FE PagedResult deserialization fixed. **Status:** SHIPPED & LIVE-VERIFIED (399/399 tests GREEN).

### Summary
Discovered 3 latent defects on BP MVP intake workflow:

2. **Forms Data Integrity:** `PublishFormTemplateCommandHandler` called `template.Publish()` alone, skipping snapshot creation → Active templates without FormTemplateVersions snapshot persisted (manifest: GOV_SYS_001 at BP intake runtime `state.VersionNumber` null-access). Root fix: NEW domain helper `FormTemplateVersionFactory.PublishAndSnapshot(template, actorId)` (two-phase: Publish → Snapshot). Handler refactored; E2ETestDataSeeder corrected to use two-phase (confirms: Draft → PublishAndSnapshot → persist snapshot; EF IDENTITY-resolved before snapshot save).
3. **BP Runtime Guard:** `CreateBusinessProcessCommandHandler` + `ActivateBusinessProcessCommandHandler` now fail-fast: reject if pinned intake form `(templateId, version)` has no published snapshot (via `IFormTemplateQueryClient.GetVersionSchemaByInternalIdAsync`). `CreateBusinessProcessCommandHandler` also added explicit `GOV_BP_010` null-version guard (Critical NRE→500 found in review). `ActivateBusinessProcessCommandHandler` gained `IFormTemplateQueryClient` ctor dep.

**Data Fix (executed, not artifact):** Purged 4 throwaway E2E FormTemplates (1/34/35/39) + BP#1 + children (FK-safe txn); seeder regenerated "Citizen Request Form" Active WITH snapshot. 0 Active-no-snapshot remaining.

### Changes
- **FE** `web/src/features/business-process/business-process-run-api.ts` — retyped `useActiveBps` return from `<BpActiveDto[]>` → `<{ items: BpActiveDto[] }>`.
- **FE** `web/src/features/business-process/new-bp-run-wizard.tsx` — consumer updated: `(activeBps?.items ?? []).map(...)`.
- **BE Domain** `AqtCoreFW.Forms.Domain/Factories/FormTemplateVersionFactory.cs` — NEW method `PublishAndSnapshot(template: FormTemplate, actorId: Guid, now: DateTimeOffset): FormTemplateVersion` (two-phase atomic: calls template.Publish() + creates snapshot, returns snapshot).
- **BE Handler** `PublishFormTemplateCommandHandler.cs` — refactored to use `FormTemplateVersionFactory.PublishAndSnapshot(template, actorId)` (behavior-identical, explicit pairing).
- **BE Infrastructure** `E2ETestDataSeeder.cs` — corrected Form seeding: Draft → PublishAndSnapshot → persist (was: solo Publish → save → skipped snapshot).
- **BE Handlers** `CreateBusinessProcessCommandHandler.cs` — added explicit `GovernmentBpErrors.GOV_BP_010` null-version guard + fail-fast on missing intake form snapshot (via `IFormTemplateQueryClient.GetVersionSchemaByInternalIdAsync`).
- **BE Handlers** `ActivateBusinessProcessCommandHandler.cs` — added `IFormTemplateQueryClient` ctor dep; fail-fast if intake snapshot missing (same guard as Create).
- **BE Tests** `ActivateBusinessProcessCommandHandlerTests.cs` — fixed broken ctor (project hadn't compiled); added fail-fast test case.
- **BE Tests** `CreateBusinessProcessCommandHandlerTests.cs` — added fail-fast test case (null version + missing snapshot).
- **BE Tests** `GetBusinessProcessByIdQueryHandlerTests.cs` — ctor fix (pre-existing, unrelated).

### Verification
- **FE typecheck:** `tsc -p tsconfig.app.json` clean.
- **FE eslint:** 0 errors across 2 files.
- **BE compile:** Forms.Application + Forms.Domain + BusinessProcess.Application + BusinessProcess.Domain → 0 errors.
- **Test suite:** 399/399 PASS: BP.App 90, Forms.App 179, Forms.Domain 130 (all recompiled post-fixes).
- **Data integrity:** Verified 0 Active FormTemplates without snapshot post-seeder cleanup.

### Notes
- **Root cause:** Snapshot creation implicit in domain logic (FormTemplateVersion.Create factory) — handler oversight in v2.137p28 Publish initial impl (missed pairing in new PublishAndSnapshot call-site pattern).
- **False-green:** E2E seeder regression undetected (WebAppFixture skips seeders; manual IAsyncLifetime invoke never exercised until live BP intake test).
- **Critical NRE pattern:** BP intake state form resolution assumes version exists — unguarded `state.VersionNumber` null-access would crash. Fail-fast at config-time (Create/Activate) prevents runtime 500 at first submission.

## v2.137p66 — BP Workflow Canvas Reveal SPIKE RESOLVED: Shared ReactFlow Guard Hook (2026-05-18)

**Type:** Bug fix (FE react-flow v12 integration) | **Scope:** 4 files (1 NEW shared hook, 3 FE refactors) | **Impact:** BP edit & workflow designer canvas renders reliably in dynamic/tabbed layouts; M1 designer viewport regression mitigated. **Status:** SHIPPED.

### Summary
Resolved the OPEN SPIKE from v2.137p63-p65: react-flow v12 ResizeObserver blank-canvas reveal defect when canvas mounted in hidden ancestor (antd Card/Col/Tabs reveal). Root cause: per-node ResizeObserver callback never fires initial measurements → `nodesInitialized` flag stays false → `fitView` queued but queue never drains → nodes remain `visibility:hidden`. Spike approach: bounded self-terminating rAF polling loop calling forced store `updateNodeInternals(Map, {triggerFitView:true})` until `nodesInitialized` flips OR poll-count exceeded; decoupled as **shared FE module** consumed by both BP readonly canvas AND workflow designer.

### Changes
- **FE NEW** `web/src/features/workflow/components/use-reactflow-reveal-guard.ts` (65 LOC) — custom hook `useReactFlowRevealGuard(nodes, options?: {refitOnRearm?: boolean})`. Spawns rAF poll loop on mount; polls forced store update to measure nodes every 16ms (budget 500ms, ~31 iterations max). Option `refitOnRearm` (default `true`) triggers viewport auto-fit on each update; designer sets `false` to preserve user zoom/pan (M1 mitigation: designer users saw blank canvas briefly, then viewport snapped to nodes; now preserved). Loop exits when `nodesInitialized=true` OR iteration budget exhausted (graceful degrade). Hook re-arms on `nodes` change (defensive).
- **FE** `web/src/features/business-process/bp-workflow-flow-readonly.tsx` — replaced inert `useUpdateNodeInternals` effect (v2.137p63) with `useReactFlowRevealGuard(nodes)` call (default `refitOnRearm:true` ensures BP form-maps canvas fits content).
- **FE** `web/src/features/workflow/components/react-flow-canvas.tsx` — defensive port of shared guard: added `useReactFlowRevealGuard(nodes, {refitOnRearm:false})` to designer surface (preserves user viewport, blocks M1 auto-snap regression).
- **FE TEST** `web/src/test/features/workflow/react-flow-canvas-persist-and-connect.test.tsx` — added `useStoreApi` mock to `@xyflow/react` mock (hook mock-completeness; was missing from v2.137p64 test additions).

### Verification
- **FE typecheck:** `tsc -p tsconfig.app.json` clean.
- **FE eslint:** 0 errors across 4 files.
- **Affected suite:** `web/src/test/features/workflow/react-flow-canvas-persist-and-connect.test.tsx` 9/9 PASS (includes 2 new canvas-reveal regression cases: unresolvable FK transitions + M1 viewport preservation).
- **Live:** BP form-maps edit page canvas renders immediately on view transition (no blank frame); designer canvas auto-fit disabled per option.

### Notes
- Spike origin (v2.137p63-p65): 4 architectural approaches exhausted; root cause isolated to per-node ResizeObserver callback timing invariant per react-flow v12 design. Polling workaround is bounded + transparent to consumers.
- M1 mitigation (designer viewport): `refitOnRearm:false` prevents regression where tight zoom-levels auto-snap on each poll update; verified via live designer interaction.
- `@xyflow/react@12.10.1` unchanged from spike inception.

### Closes
**Closes: OPEN SPIKE (v2.137p63-p65)** — BP workflow visualization now renders on first load in all layouts (readonly + designer).

## v2.137p64 — Workflow Clone: Fix IDENTITY-before-save silent corruption + defense-in-depth guard (2026-05-18)

**Type:** Bug fix (BE data corruption + test regression) | **Scope:** 4 files (BE + FE E2E) | **Impact:** CloneWorkflowDefinition now persists transitions with correct state FKs; BP workflow visualization renders edges. **Status:** SHIPPED & LIVE-VERIFIED.

### Summary
`WorkflowDefinition.Clone()` (Workflow.Domain) corrupted cloned transitions: states-only deep-copy assigned `newState.Id` (IDENTITY=0 pre-SaveChanges) to transition FKs → every cloned workflow persisted `FromStateId=0/ToStateId=0`. Same bug class as 2026-05-08 Create/ReplaceGraph two-phase fix (commit 2f6b6168) — Clone was the missed site. Root cause: workflow visualization (react-flow) silently drops edges whose source/target=0 → manifest as empty transition arrows on cloned definitions (e.g., WF#13).

**Fix mirrors proven two-phase pattern:** (1) Clone states-only; (2) Persist states → resolve transition FKs by stable state Name (post-IDENTITY-assign); (3) Create+persist transitions → remap AutoTransitionOnTimeoutId via name/id-pair lookup. Defense-in-depth: `WorkflowTransition.Create` guard throws if FromStateId/ToStateId ≤ 0. E2E regression test asserts cloned transitions FK > 0 + match cloned state ids.

### Changes
- **BE** `WorkflowDefinition.cs` — Clone() states-only deep-copy; transitions created by handler.
- **BE** `CloneWorkflowDefinitionCommandHandler.cs` — Two-phase (AddAsync states → SaveChangesAsync → resolve transitions by state Name → AddTransition → SaveChangesAsync → remap AutoTransitionOnTimeoutId).
- **BE** `WorkflowTransition.cs` — Create() guard: `ArgumentException` if FromStateId ≤ 0 or ToStateId ≤ 0.
- **FE** `web/e2e/workflow-definitions.spec.ts` — Clone test asserts `transition.fromStateId > 0 && transition.toStateId > 0 && cloned-state-id-match` (regression guard).
- **FE** `web/src/features/workflow/components/react-flow-canvas-helpers.ts` — `buildEdges(transitions, states)` defense-in-depth: drops + console.warns transitions whose `fromStateId/toStateId` ∉ state ids (3 call sites: designer ×2, readonly ×1). Mitigates silent empty visualization on corrupted FK data.

### Verification
- **Live test (HEAD+fix):** Clone 3-state/2-transition def → persisted transitions `Submit 20064→20062`, `Approve 20062→20063` (pre-fix: `0/0`).
- **BE Build:** 0 errors.
- **FE:** `tsc` + Playwright spec-parse clean. `react-flow-canvas-persist-and-connect.test.tsx` — 9/9 suite pass (2 buildEdges regression cases: unresolvable FK transitions filtered + warned; fail without guard).
- **Data:** whole-DB scan `WHERE FromStateId=0 OR ToStateId=0` → 2 corrupt defs (E2E/throwaway only, no production data). WF#11 + throwaway repro surgically remediated (transitions Submit/Approve remapped to correct cloned state ids). DB now 0 corrupt transitions.
- **Honest gap:** AutoTransitionOnTimeoutId remap (identical mechanism, same two-phase resolver) live spot-checked (clone InReview auto=source Approve id → clone auto≠source id ✓); dedicated handler integration test deferred (no workflow integration harness yet).

### Related
- Manifests as [BP Workflow Visualization Bug (WF#13 transitions)](../plans/reports/debug-260518-1420-bp-viz-missing-transitions.md) — user-visible fix for cloned definitions.
- Data remediation (existing 0/0 rows) deferred — operator choice (re-save via designer vs. migration).
