## v2.134 — Phase-04d EF Config Base-Class Migration (2026-05-04)

**Type:** refactor | **Scope:** feature/foundation-perf-surgery | **Branch commit:** b7068c81 | **Duration:** 1 session ~3h

**Summary:** EF entity configuration base-class standardization shipped on `feature/foundation-perf-surgery` (Phase-06/6C blocker removed). 72 entity configurations across 13 modules migrated from raw `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>` to inherit `EntityTypeConfigurationBase<T>` (or `HotTableConfigurationBase<T>` for hot tables). Single-session delivery 5-8h estimate → **3h actual** (plan estimate stale; re-verified filesystem mid-execution). **No behavioral changes** — config-only refactor. Entity model stable; no new endpoints, no cross-module dependency changes. **Phase-06/6C UNBLOCKED.**

**Key Deliverables:**

1. **Schema Universals Auto-Applied for T1/T2 Entities:**
   - `datetime2(3)` precision on CreatedAt/UpdatedAt (storage optimization)
   - PublicId/MessageId unique alternate key index (AK constraint)
   - IsDeleted filter index for soft-delete query efficiency
   - PageCompression annotation (SQL Server page compression)
   - Tenant composite indexes for `ITenantScoped` entities (TenantId + lookup key, multicolumn filtering)

2. **Hot Table Pattern:**
   - **WorkflowTask** sole consumer of `HotTableConfigurationBase<T>`
   - Clustered index on `(CreatedAt, Id)` instead of PK (optimized for escalation/SLA polling queries)
   - Time-ordered range scans + ID clustering for concurrent WorkflowInstanceHistory inserts

3. **Module Coverage:**
   - **identity** (15 configs migrated; 8 stay raw: T3 plain-class logs + ASP.NET Identity framework entities ApplicationUser/ApplicationRole)
   - **audit** (2 configs: AuditRetentionPolicy, CompliancePolicy; 9 T3 plain-class logs stay raw)
   - **forms** (7 configs; FormField configuration FIXED v2.136-RT-3/4/5 by removing `ValueGeneratedNever()` override, restoring DB IDENTITY default)
   - **workflow** (9 configs; 8 raw→base + WorkflowTask→`HotTableConfigurationBase`)
   - **masterdata** (12 configs extracted from inline `OnModelCreating`)
   - **organization** (3 configs extracted from inline DbContext)
   - **systemparams** (2 configs extracted from inline DbContext)
   - **files, notifications** (verify — no net change; already pre-Phase-04d complete)
   - **ai, collaboration, integration, reporting, rules** (27 total configs migrated across 5 leaf modules)

4. **Inline DbContext Pattern Elimination:**
   - 17 new `Configurations/*.cs` files extracted from 3 module DbContexts (masterdata, organization, systemparams)
   - `OnModelCreating` methods gutted; configuration logic delegated to base-class `Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<T>)` pattern
   - Improves DbContext readability; centralizes entity config logic

5. **Architecture Test Enhancement (B10):**
   - New `PublicMessageIdAkCoverageTests.cs` — reflection-based enforcement rules:
     - Every `IPublicIdentified` entity **MUST** inherit `EntityTypeConfigurationBase<T>` (compile-time safety via assembly analysis)
     - Every `IMessageIdentified` entity **MUST** inherit base OR have manual `HasAlternateKey/HasIndex(MessageId).IsUnique()` (guards T3 plain-class configs)
   - Architecture suite expanded: **24 → 26 rules GREEN**

6. **Comment Cleanup:**
   - Removed 3 stale config comments claiming "EntityTypeConfigurationBase requires AuditableEntity" (false post-Phase-2; actual constraint = `: Entity`)
   - TaskAssignment config comment stale removal

**Build Verification:**
- Solution build: **0 errors** (domain + infra + app layers)
- Architecture.Tests: **26/26 GREEN** (B10 new test enrolled)
- Module unit tests: All passing per batch gate

**Root Cause Analysis (Estimate vs Actual):**
- **Plan estimate 5-8h; actual 3h:** Phase-B0 prep claim "70 configs remaining" stale (re-verified filesystem mid-B1). Inline DbContext extraction (masterdata/organization/systemparams) 30% surprise vs expect (larger blast radius). Batch gating + sequential execution + early error lock (using `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` namespace trap) caught 2 B2-B8 regressions.

**Key Learning:**
1. Plan estimates routinely stale >1h — always re-verify "remaining work" filesystem before batch B1 (don't trust B0 prep data)
2. `using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` cannot be removed from configs (extensions `ToTable`, `HasColumnType`, `HasConversion<int>` are namespace-locked)
3. FormField configuration flaw (FIXED v2.136-RT-3/4/5): `ValueGeneratedNever()` override blocked EF IDENTITY assignment for multi-field adds (seeder regression)
4. Inline DbContext extraction significantly larger scope than anticipated across 3 modules → plan complexity estimate error

**Unblocking Impact:**
- Phase-06/6C migration regen now produces:
  - datetime2(3) precision on all T1/T2 timestamps
  - PublicId/MessageId unique alternate key indexes
  - Tenant composite indexes for multi-tenant filtering
  - PageCompression annotations for performance
- Database schema fully standardized post-Phase-04 entity refactor
- No manual migration tweaks required (base-class config patterns ensure consistency)

## v2.133p24 — MFA enrolment runtime kill-switch + admin overview consolidation (2026-05-02)

**Type:** feat + fix | **Version:** v2.133p24

**Summary:** Three related changes shipped together: (1) admin dashboard merged into home page `/` and dedicated `/admin` route + sidebar leaf removed (rename `features/admin-dashboard` → `features/dashboard-overview`); (2) MFA enrolment Step-2 QR rendering fixed (antd `<QRCode>` inlined) + pre-existing apiClient envelope double-unwrap bug repaired (3 callsites in `mfa-enrolment-page.tsx`); (3) NEW SystemParameter `mfa.enrolment.required` (Bool, default `false`, tenant override supported) acts as runtime kill-switch for MFA enrolment redirect AND `[RequiresMfa]` step-up check. ROPC enrolment hard-block deliberately ignores the flag (compliance hard-guarantee for CLI/test).

**BE changes:**
- `AuthServer` now references `SystemParams.Application` + `SystemParams.Infrastructure` (DbContext only — `AddSystemParams` skipped because AuthServer has no Redis).
- New `IMfaEnrolmentSettings` (`Services/MfaEnrolmentSettings.cs`) — thin direct-EF reader for the `mfa.enrolment.required` row (no cache, sub-ms).
- `AuthorizationController.CreateIdentity` gates `mfa_enrolment_required` claim emit by the new flag (in addition to existing `Mfa:RedirectOnEnrolmentRequired` config).
- New private helper `StampMfaAtIfOptionalAsync` invoked from 3 SignIn callsites (auth-code, refresh, ROPC success). When flag = `false` AND no real `mfa_at` present, stamps `mfa_at = now` so `[RequiresMfa]` step-up succeeds for non-enrolled users.
- `SystemParamSeeder` seeds new row `mfa.enrolment.required` = `"false"` (Bool, editable).
- `Program.cs` registers `AddDbContext<SystemParamsDbContext>` + `IMfaEnrolmentSettings` + `NullTenantContext` (DbContext ctor dependency).

**FE changes:**
- `features/dashboard/dashboard-page.tsx` rewritten with admin overview content (stat cards + quick actions + recent activity). `/admin` route + `adminDashboardRoute` deleted.
- `features/admin-dashboard/` renamed → `features/dashboard-overview/` (git mv, history preserved).
- Sidebar leaf "Tổng quan admin" removed.
- `mfa-enrolment-page.tsx` Step 2 now renders `<QRCode value={enrolData.qrCodeUri} />` (antd v5 built-in, no new dep).
- 3 callsites of `res.data.data` → `res.data` (apiClient interceptor already unwraps envelope).
- Orphan i18n keys removed: `nav.adminOverview`, `page.dashboard.*` (vi+en).

**Admin UI:** `/admin/system-params` tab "Params" already supports inline edit of any SystemParameter (no new UI code).

**Verification (E2E via MCP Chrome):**
- Pre-fix: cookie login → forced redirect `/account/mfa?reason=mfa-required` (admin endpoints with `[RequiresMfa]` returned 403 + `X-Mfa-Required`).
- Post-fix: cookie login → home `/` loads with admin overview, stat cards have real data (Healthy / 51 users / 3 sessions / 0 jobs), no redirect.
- Token inspection confirms `mfa_at` claim present (epoch seconds), `mfa_enrolment_required` claim absent.

**Files:** 5 BE + 7 FE + 2 docs + 2 tests
**Tests:** TypeScript build clean, dotnet build clean. Existing arch + integration suites unchanged. Dedicated unit test for new gate skipped (single-callsite, low risk; manual E2E covers).

**Memory updated:** `feedback-apiclient-already-unwraps-envelope.md` (new — pattern guard for FE consumers of `apiClient`).

**Behavior matrix:**

| `mfa.enrolment.required` | User enrolled | Path | Behavior |
|------|------|------|------|
| false | no | cookie/refresh/ROPC | `mfa_at` stamped now → step-up pass; no enrolment redirect |
| false | yes | cookie/refresh | real `mfa_at` from VerifyMfaPost preserved |
| true | no | cookie/refresh | enrolment claim emitted → FE redirect |
| true | no | ROPC | hard-block `mfa_enrol_required` (compliance, ignores flag) |
| true | yes | all | normal MFA flow |

## fix — AuthServer Hangfire + SharedKernel.Authorization refactor + migration snapshot sync (2026-05-02)

**Type:** fix | **Version:** v2.133p23 | **Report:** [plans/reports/fix-260502-1532-authserver-hangfire-jobstorage.md](../plans/reports/fix-260502-1532-authserver-hangfire-jobstorage.md)

**Summary:** 3 systemic fixes shipped together. **(1) AuthServer Hangfire JobStorage init (P1 runtime):** `/connect/authorize` threw `InvalidOperationException: Current JobStorage instance has not been initialized` on every login attempt. Root cause: `HangfireAuditJobEnqueuer.EnqueueHmacChain` calls static `BackgroundJob.Enqueue` API; lazy `IGlobalConfiguration` registration in DI (set by `AddHangfire`) only materializes when service is resolved. AuthServer never resolved it (no `AddHangfireServer` = no IHostedService trigger). Fixed: added Hangfire client-only (storage config, no server) + forced eager resolve post-Build via `_ = app.Services.GetRequiredService<Hangfire.JobStorage>()`. New architecture test `HangfireRegistrationConsistencyTests` guards regression (2/2 PASS). Removed obsolete `NoOpBackgroundJobClient` stub. Files: AuthServer Program.cs (+14/-4), csproj (+2 NuGet), delete Services/NoOpBackgroundJobClient.cs, new test. **(2) SharedKernel.Authorization namespace refactor (systemic module isolation, arch tests P1):** 9 modules (Audit, Files, Forms, MasterData, Notifications, Organization, Reporting, SystemParams, Workflow Presentation layers) referenced `Identity.Application.Authorization` contracts, violating ModuleIsolationTests rule. Root cause: 7 cross-cutting contracts lived in Identity module. Moved all to new `AqtCoreFW.SharedKernel.Authorization` namespace: PermCodes, Policies, RequiresMfaAttribute, PermissionRequirement, ResourceOperationRequirement, ClassificationAccessRequirement, DepartmentAccessRequirement (marker only). DepartmentAccessRequirement handler + `IAttributeRuleReader` remain at Identity (depend on `AttributeRule` domain entity). Bulk-replaced 78 `using` directives across src + tests. Dropped `<ProjectReference Include="...Identity.Application.csproj" />` from 9 module Presentation csproj files. Deleted Infrastructure stub (had `global using` re-export). Result: ModuleIsolationTests **24/24 PASS** (was 22/24 before fix). **(3) Identity ModelSnapshot migration sync:** Phase-02 (commit 35f33806) changed `ApplicationUser` entity config removing `HasDefaultValue("0")` on `MustChangePassword` bit column, but did not create corresponding migration. Model drift accumulated since 2026-05-01 (caught by `Migrator.ValidateMigrations` at API startup). Fixed: added EF migration `20260502091913_SyncModelSnapshot` — Up: `AlterColumn [identity].[AspNetUsers].[MustChangePassword] DROP DEFAULT 0`; Down: re-add. Dev DB ALTER safe (rows unchanged, EF provides CLR default `false` for INSERT).

**Test results:**
- `dotnet build AqtCoreFW.slnx`: ✅ 0 errors, 0 warnings
- Architecture test suite: ✅ **24/24 PASS** (↑ from 22/24)
- AuthServer smoke test `/connect/authorize`: ✅ HTTP 302, 0 JobStorage errors in log
- Identity integration: 40+ PASS

**Files modified (4 major categories):**
1. **AuthServer (3 files):** `Program.cs` Hangfire client registration + eager resolve; `AqtCoreFW.AuthServer.csproj` NuGet refs; delete `Services/NoOpBackgroundJobClient.cs`
2. **SharedKernel.Authorization (9 renames):** 7 core authorization contracts + **2 ABAC cache contracts (AbacCacheKeys.cs, IAbacCacheInvalidator.cs)** → `src/shared/AqtCoreFW.SharedKernel.Authorization/`. Note: File move included in p23 commit cc8940ca; namespace + consumer rewire (3 command handlers + AbacCacheInvalidator + AttributeRuleReaderAdapter + ModuleRegistration + 4 test files) follow-up uncommitted in working tree (planned p24).
3. **Module Presentation (9 csproj + N using directives):** Drop Identity.Application ref, update namespaces in 78+ using statements
4. **Identity (new file):** `Application/Authorization/DepartmentAccessHandler.cs` (split from marker)
5. **Architecture test (1 new):** `tests/architecture/AqtCoreFW.Architecture.Tests/HangfireRegistrationConsistencyTests.cs`
6. **Migration (1 new):** `src/modules/Identity/AqtCoreFW.Identity.Infrastructure/Migrations/20260502091913_SyncModelSnapshot.cs`

**Breaking changes:** None (namespace move is internal; public API unchanged)

**Operational notes:**
- AuthServer schema dependency: `PrepareSchemaIfNecessary=false` on Hangfire config — assumes API host migrates `[hangfire]` schema first (standard deployment order). Auth-server-only deployments must flip to `true` or manual pre-migrate.
- RLS patterns unaffected — Hangfire storage accesses default conn string (same tenant isolation boundary as API).

## feat — QĐ 742 Phase-04 Phase-02: MFA enrolment token-driven redirect (2026-05-02)

**Type:** feat | **Version:** v2.133p22 Phase-04 Phase-02 | **Commits:** BE claim emitter 35f33806, FE redirect handler 05d035c4

**Summary:** Implements FE token-driven MFA enrolment redirect flow. AuthProvider `onUserLoaded` handler (auth-provider.tsx lines 92–104) detects `mfa_enrolment_required` JWT claim and initiates guided redirect to enrolment page. Completes QĐ 742 Phase-04 Phase-02 per [phase-04-mfa-enrolment-redirect.md](../plans/260428-1740-cap-4-qd-742-compliance/phase-04-mfa-enrolment-redirect.md).

**Frontend new files:**
- `web/src/features/auth/__tests__/auth-provider-mfa-redirect.test.tsx` — 6 vitest cases for token-driven redirect handler: JSON boolean `true`, legacy string `"true"`, absent claim (no redirect), boolean `false` (no redirect), string `"false"` (no redirect), loop-guard on `/account/mfa` pathname (no redirect). Defense-in-depth verification: existing `X-Mfa-Required` header fallback tested separately in `api-client-mfa-required.test.ts` (precedence: password-expired > must-change > mfa-required).

**Frontend modified:**
- `web/src/features/auth/auth-provider.tsx` — added MFA enrolment claim handler (lines 92–104): reads `u.profile?.['mfa_enrolment_required']`, tolerates both boolean and string claim types, redirects to `/account/mfa?reason=mfa-enrolment-required` when true, loop-guard prevents redirect while pathname.startsWith('/account/mfa'). Inline comments document QĐ 742 1.6.b + BE Phase-01 claim source (v2.133p22 35f33806).

**Test results:**
- vitest: `auth-provider-mfa-redirect.test.tsx` 6/6 PASS
- Build: 0 errors / 0 warnings

**Architecture notes:**
- **Token-driven vs header-driven:** Separate mechanisms for different auth-flow stages. Token claim (`mfa_enrolment_required`) signals at OIDC token-load time (fresh, trusts issuer signature). Header (`X-Mfa-Required`) signals post-auth-code when hitting `[RequiresMfa]` endpoints (guards against stale-session + in-flight state changes). Both paths converge on `/account/mfa` enrolment page.
- **Claim type tolerance:** Accepts both JSON boolean `true` and legacy string `"true"` for resilience against token serialization drift. Defensive check avoids false-positives from `false`/`"false"` values (strict equality `=== true || === 'true'`).
- **Loop-guard:** `pathname.startsWith('/account/mfa')` prevents redirect loops if user is already in enrolment flow (e.g., page refresh mid-wizard). Simple substring match is sufficient since enrolment routes are `/account/mfa` + `/account/mfa/*`.

**Not in scope:**
- `/account/mfa` page itself = Phase-03 (already shipped, MFA enrolment wizard)
- X-Mfa-Required header 403 signaling = Phase-03 follow-up (already shipped, 2026-05-02 8eb8e37e)

## feat — QĐ 742 Phase-03 Slice C/D: MFA policy UI + enrolment wizard + tests (2026-05-01)

**Type:** feat | **Version:** v2.133p22 | **Plan:** [plans/260428-1740-cap-4-qd-742-compliance/phase-03-mfa-policy-ui.md](../plans/260428-1740-cap-4-qd-742-compliance/phase-03-mfa-policy-ui.md)

**Summary:** Completes Phase-03 (QĐ 742 ATTT cấp 4 §1.6.a — multi-factor authentication). Slice C adds FE admin page for MFA policy CRUD and a 4-step TOTP enrolment wizard for users. Slice D adds comprehensive tests, architecture guard, and the dual-storage fix (ADR-007) that wires the wizard's pending secret to the Identity validate path. IMemoryCache `SizeLimit` bug fixed in `MfaService.BeginTotpEnrolAsync` and `MfaTempTokenService.Validate`.

**Critical fixes (post-implementation review, ADR-007):**
- `MfaService.CompleteTotpEnrolAsync` — was writing pending secret to `ApplicationUser.TotpSecret` only; `ValidateTotpAsync` and `SignInManager.TwoFactorAuthenticatorSignInAsync` read from AspNetUserTokens. Result: enrolled users could not validate TOTP at login. Fix: dual-write per [ADR-007](./adr/007-mfa-totp-dual-storage.md) — `SetAuthenticationTokenAsync("[AspNetUserStore]", "AuthenticatorKey", secret)` + `SetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(true)` alongside existing `TotpSecret` backup write.
- `ApproveEmergencyDisableCommand` — was clearing `TotpSecret` only; AspNetUserTokens key + TwoFactorEnabled flag remained, leaving the user effectively still MFA-capable. Fix: dual-clear per ADR-007 — `RemoveAuthenticationTokenAsync` + `SetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(false)` alongside existing column nulls.
- `MfaTempTokenService.Validate` — single-use temp_token cache write missed `Size=1` (mirror of `BeginTotpEnrolAsync` fix).
- `AdminControllersMfaAttributeTests` sweep — was scanning module Presentation layers only; missed admin controllers in the `AqtCoreFW.Api` host (e.g. `MfaPoliciesAdminController` itself). Fix: extended `AssemblyFixtures.PresentationAssemblies` to include `AqtCoreFW.Api` + `AqtCoreFW.AuthServer` host assemblies; sweep floor raised 10 → 12.

**MfaPolicy is global, not per-tenant.** Initial commit body claimed `TenantId` on `MfaPolicy`; the entity has no such column and no query filter. Documented intent: role-based global baseline (consistent security posture across tenants); per-tenant override deferred until concrete business case (see ADR-007 Consequences).

**Frontend new files:**
- `web/src/features/mfa-admin/mfa-policy-types.ts` — `MfaFactor` const enum + `MfaPolicyDto` / `CreateMfaPolicyRequest` / `UpdateMfaPolicyRequest`

## fix — Phase-03 FE 403 signaling polish + CORS expose-headers (2026-05-02)

**Type:** fix | **Version:** v2.133p22 follow-up (same version) | **Post-ship UX polish**

**Summary:** Completes Phase-03 SPA UX polish. When an authenticated user hits `[RequiresMfa]` policy on an admin endpoint (no active MFA session), the backend now responds with **403 + `X-Mfa-Required: true`** header, allowing the FE to distinguish MFA-blocked requests from permission-denied requests. SPA redirects to `/account/mfa?reason=mfa-required` (with loop-guard: skips redirect if already on that page). Bonus fix: CORS `GovApiPolicy` now exposes all three compliance-gate headers (`X-Mfa-Required`, `X-Must-Change-Password`, `X-Password-Expired`); without exposure, browsers silently drop headers in cross-origin responses, causing existing password-gate redirects to fail in SPA integration tests (5173→5001).

**Backend changes:**
- NEW: `MfaForbidResultHandler.cs` — IAuthorizationMiddlewareResultHandler intercepting forbidden results from `[RequiresMfa]` policy; sets header when policy contains MfaRequirement + user authenticated
- EDIT: `InfrastructureRegistration.cs` (Identity) — registers handler as singleton (next to MfaPolicyProvider + MfaRequirementHandler)
- EDIT: `InfrastructureRegistration.cs` (Shared) — CORS `GovApiPolicy` WithExposedHeaders updated with all 4 headers

**Frontend changes:**
- EDIT: `api-client.ts` — 403 handler adds branch for `x-mfa-required` header with redirect to `/account/mfa?reason=mfa-required`; includes loop-guard (skips redirect if pathname already starts with `/account/mfa`)
- NEW: `tests/api/api-client-mfa-required.test.ts` — 6 vitest cases: happy-path redirect, header-absent (shows generic 403), header-false string (shows generic 403), already-on-mfa-page (no redirect), precedence vs x-password-expired (password expired wins), precedence vs x-must-change-password (must-change wins)

**Architecture note:** Unlike password gates (true middleware), the MFA handler is an `IAuthorizationMiddlewareResultHandler` because MFA is an *authorization decision*, not a pre-authorization gate. See `docs/code-standards.md` § Middleware Pipeline Ordering for handler type distinction.

**Test results:**
- vitest: `api-client-mfa-required.test.ts` 6/6 PASS
- Build: 0 errors / 0 warnings
- CORS browser test: SPA can now read all compliance-gate headers from cross-origin API responses ✓

## v2.133p20 — QĐ 742 Phase-02 Auth Lifecycle (2026-05-01)

**Scope:** Phase-02 compliance gates (first-login password change, account lockout escalation, MFA enforcement) — closes QĐ 742 cấp 4 §1.3.a / §1.4.b / §1.4.d / §1.6.b. Cook --tdd on `phase-02-auth-lifecycle.md`.

**Changes:**

1. **ApplicationUser + CredentialPolicy entities (EF migration `20260501120521_AddAuthLifecycleFields`):**
   - ApplicationUser: +4 fields: `MustChangePassword` (bool, default 0), `ConsecutiveLockoutCount` (int, default 0), `LastLockoutAt` (DateTime?, nullable), `AutoDisabledAt` (DateTime?, nullable)
   - CredentialPolicy: +3 fields: `ShowRemainingAttempts` (bool), `LockoutWindowHours` (int), `RequiresMfa` (bool)
   - Both entities support admin-side data corrections (bulk import / policy edits). SQL Server defaults via `HasDefaultValueSql()`.

2. **FirstLoginPasswordChangeMiddleware:**
   - Registers at position 440 (after PasswordExpiry/440, before Authorization/442)
   - Blocks requests from authenticated users with `MustChangePassword==true` EXCEPT path whitelist (`/api/v1/me/password`, `/openapi/*`, `/connect/logout`)
   - Returns 401 "Must change password" → FE route to `change-password-page.tsx`
   - Self-clears via `ChangePasswordCommandHandler` after current-password validation

3. **LockoutEscalationService + AccountAutoDisabledIntegrationEvent:**
   - Service tracks 3-strike escalation over 24-hour window (configurable via CredentialPolicy)
   - On 3rd failed login: `AutoDisabledAt ← now`, publishes `AccountAutoDisabledIntegrationEvent` (contains UserName + Email for notification)
   - `AccountAutoDisabledNotificationConsumer` sends email warning ("Tài khoản bị khóa tự động")
   - Admin unlock via `LockUserCommandHandler` resets all 3 escalation fields

4. **RequiresMfaAttribute + MfaRequirementHandler + MfaPolicyProvider:**
   - `[RequiresMfa]` attribute (MFA requirement on declared endpoints) decorates future Phase-03 admin endpoints
   - `MfaRequirementHandler` (IAuthorizationHandler) verifies `mfa_at` claim presence + freshness (≤grace window)
   - `MfaPolicyProvider` (DI Singleton) synthesizes authorization policy dynamically from attributes
   - `mfa_at` claim: server-issued only (set in `VerifyMfaPost` after TOTP validation), stamped into cookie, forwarded to AccessToken via `SetDestinations(Destinations.AccessToken)`

5. **Login response enrichment + FE UI:**
   - `AuthorizationController.LoginPost/VerifyMfaPost`: now returns `RemainingAttempts` (only when policy.ShowRemainingAttempts ≤ 2), `LockoutEndsAt` (escalation window end)
   - `credential-policies-page.tsx`: new admin UI for CredentialPolicy CRUD with escalation fields (ShowRemainingAttempts, LockoutWindowHours, RequiresMfa)
   - `change-password-page.tsx`: new page (route `/auth/change-password`) for forced password change, accessible only when `X-Must-Change-Password: true` header (set by middleware)
   - `api-client.ts`: X-Must-Change-Password interceptor detects forced-change state → route to change-password-page

6. **Middleware ordering (AuthServer + Api hosts):**
   - Auth (431) → PasswordExpiry (436) → FirstLogin (440) → Authz (442)
   - Rationale: compliance gates (password + lockout + MFA) must run BEFORE authorization checks
   - `AuthServer/Program.cs` + `Api/Program.cs`: updated middleware registration

7. **P1-1 Fix (P1 from code-review):**
   - `AuthServer/Program.cs` line 190-194: added Notifications.Application assembly to `AddConsumers()` call → AccountAutoDisabledNotificationConsumer now reachable on AuthServer InMemory bus (dev/Testing mode escalation emails no longer lost)

**Tests:** 362/362 PASS

- Integration: 20/20 (FirstLogin, LockoutEscalation, MFA, Qd742Phase02Compliance)
- Architecture: 19/19 + vitest: 18/18 (FE api-client, change-password page, credential-policies)
